words.enDefinition: an association organized to promote art or science or education

examples.en: She joined a local science institute that funds research by young students.
examples.zh: 她加入了一家资助年轻学生做研究的科学「学会」。

examples.en: The city's history institute will open its archives to the public next month.
examples.zh: 这家历史「学会」下个月将向公众开放馆藏档案。

words.enDefinition: group of people who differ racially or politically from a larger group of which it is a part

examples.en: The city offers free evening classes to support minority families downtown.
examples.zh: 该市为市中心的「少数群体」家庭提供免费夜校课程。

examples.en: As a minority in the committee, our ideas rarely win enough votes.
examples.zh: 作为委员会里的「少数派」，我们的想法很少能拿到足够的票数。

words.enDefinition: has little chance of being the case or coming about

examples.en: The bakery rarely has croissants left by noon, and today is unlikely to be different.
examples.zh: 面包店到中午很少剩下牛角包，今天也「不太可能」例外。

examples.en: Heavy rain makes a picnic in the park unlikely this weekend.
examples.zh: 大雨让这周末在公园野餐变得「不太可能」。

words.enDefinition: an amount that is twice as great as another; a drink or portion made twice the usual size

examples.en: My rent this year is almost double what I paid three years ago.
examples.zh: 我今年的房租几乎是三年前的「两倍」。

examples.en: He ordered a double at the cafe because he had to study all night.
examples.zh: 他在咖啡店点了杯「双份」，因为要熬夜复习。

words.enDefinition: cause to be structured or ordered or operating according to some principle or idea

examples.en: The students organized a car wash to raise money for their team trip.
examples.zh: 学生们「组织」了一场洗车义卖，为团队旅行筹钱。

examples.en: She spent the whole Sunday afternoon organizing her closet into labeled boxes.
examples.zh: 她花了整个周日下午把衣柜「整理」成贴好标签的几个箱子。

words.enDefinition: someone who shows the way by leading or advising

examples.en: Our guide in Kyoto knew every hidden alley near the old temples.
examples.zh: 我们在京都的「导游」熟知古寺附近每一条隐秘小巷。

examples.en: An experienced mountain guide checked our ropes twice before the climb.
examples.zh: 一位经验丰富的登山「向导」在攀登前把我们的绳索检查了两遍。

words.enDefinition: an extended fictional work in prose; usually in the form of a story

examples.en: She finished the mystery novel in two late nights last week.
examples.zh: 上周她熬了两个深夜，读完了那本悬疑「小说」。

examples.en: My grandfather wrote a short novel about his childhood on a farm.
examples.zh: 祖父写了一部关于农场童年的中篇「小说」。

words.enDefinition: feeling safe and confident, without fear or worry

examples.en: A steady paycheck made him feel secure enough to rent his own flat.
examples.zh: 稳定的收入让他足够「安心」，敢于租下自己的公寓。

examples.en: The baby sleeps more soundly when she feels secure in her mother's arms.
examples.zh: 宝宝在妈妈怀里感到「安心」时，睡得格外沉。

words.enDefinition: an energetic attempt to achieve something

examples.en: Her long struggle with the illness taught the whole family patience.
examples.zh: 她与疾病的长期「抗争」教会了全家人耐心。

examples.en: The rescue team's struggle through the snowstorm lasted nearly six hours.
examples.zh: 救援队在暴风雪中「苦苦挣扎」，走了近六个小时。

words.enDefinition: an artistic form of nonverbal communication

examples.en: The wedding ended with everyone joining a traditional folk dance.
examples.zh: 婚礼最后，大家一同跳起了一段民族「舞蹈」。

examples.en: Her modern dance piece brought the whole audience to its feet.
examples.zh: 她的现代「舞」让全场观众都起立鼓掌。

words.enDefinition: the person in command of a ship or aircraft

examples.en: The captain announced that we would reach the harbor before sunset.
examples.zh: 「船长」广播说我们能在日落前抵达港口。

examples.en: Our boat captain slowed the engine whenever dolphins appeared beside us.
examples.zh: 每当海豚出现在船边，我们的「船长」都会放慢引擎。

words.enDefinition: something intended to communicate a particular impression

examples.en: The library's holiday display of paper lanterns drew a large crowd.
examples.zh: 图书馆的节日纸灯「陈列」吸引了大批读者。

examples.en: The harbor's New Year firework display lasted nearly twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 港口的新年烟花「表演」持续了将近二十分钟。

words.enDefinition: the act of escaping physically

examples.en: The rabbit made a quick escape the moment the gate swung open.
examples.zh: 栅栏门一晃开，兔子就趁机「逃脱」了。

examples.en: Firefighters showed every hotel guest the escape route to the stairwell.
examples.zh: 消防员向酒店每位住客展示了通往楼梯间的「逃生」路线。

words.enDefinition: investigate scientifically

examples.en: The police investigated the strange noises reported behind the supermarket.
examples.zh: 警方「调查」了有人报警称超市后巷传出的怪声。

examples.en: Mom investigated the burnt smell drifting out of the kitchen.
examples.zh: 妈妈进厨房「查」了查那股焦糊味是从哪儿来的。

words.enDefinition: not either; not one or the other

examples.en: My brother doesn't like spicy food, and neither do I.
examples.zh: 我哥哥不吃辣，我「也」不吃。

examples.en: The first bus didn't stop, and neither did the second.
examples.zh: 第一班车没停，第二班「也」没停。

words.enDefinition: narrow strait connecting two bodies of water

examples.en: The kayak barely squeezed through the narrow between the two islands.
examples.zh: 皮划艇勉强挤过两座岛屿之间的「狭窄水道」。

examples.en: In the old wall there is a narrow where only one cart fits.
examples.zh: 老城墙上有一处「狭窄通道」，仅容一辆马车通过。

words.enDefinition: mental or emotional strain caused by difficult or demanding circumstances

examples.en: Final exams put a lot of stress on students living in the dorms.
examples.zh: 期末考试给住在宿舍的学生带来了很大「压力」。

examples.en: Soft piano music helps me release stress after a long shift.
examples.zh: 漫长班次结束后，轻柔的钢琴曲帮我「释放压力」。

words.enDefinition: attain success or reach a desired goal

examples.en: After three failed attempts, she finally succeeded in fixing the bicycle chain.
examples.zh: 失败三次之后，她终于「成功」修好了自行车链条。

examples.en: If you keep practicing every evening, you will succeed eventually.
examples.zh: 只要你每晚坚持练习，总有一天会「成功」。

words.enDefinition: to protect someone or something from attack, criticism, or harm

examples.en: Mom defended my little brother when the neighbors blamed him for the broken window.
examples.zh: 邻居们把打碎窗户的事怪到弟弟头上时，妈妈站出来「维护」了他。

examples.en: The old seawall defended the fishing village from the autumn storm.
examples.zh: 这道老海堤在秋天的风暴中「保护」了渔村。

words.enDefinition: another possibility or choice that can be used instead

examples.en: Since the highway was blocked, we took the coast road as an alternative.
examples.zh: 高速公路被封后，我们改走沿海公路作为「替代路线」。

examples.en: If the medicine doesn't work, surgery may be the only alternative.
examples.zh: 如果药物不起作用，手术也许是唯一的「替代方案」。

words.enDefinition: give sanction to

examples.en: My parents approved of my decision to study art abroad.
examples.zh: 父母「赞同」我出国学艺术的决定。

examples.en: The manager approved my leave request within just an hour this morning.
examples.zh: 经理今天上午不到一小时就「批准」了我的请假申请。

words.enDefinition: exercising caution or showing care or attention

examples.en: Be careful with that hot pan, because the handle doesn't stay cool.
examples.zh: 端那口热锅时要「小心」，把手可不隔热。

examples.en: She is a careful driver who always checks her mirrors twice.
examples.zh: 她开车很「小心」，总会把后视镜看两遍。

words.enDefinition: leader engaged in civil administration

examples.en: The local politician visited our school to talk about recycling programs.
examples.zh: 那位本地「政治人物」来我们学校谈垃圾分类回收。

examples.en: My cousin wants to become a politician and improve the city's buses.
examples.zh: 我表哥想成为「政治家」，改善市里的公交车服务。

words.enDefinition: single distinct event

examples.en: The waiter handled the spilled soup incident with a smile and free dessert.
examples.zh: 对于打翻汤的「小插曲」，服务员微笑着送上了免费甜点。

examples.en: Police reviewed camera footage after last night's incident in the parking lot.
examples.zh: 昨晚停车场「事件」发生后，警方调取了监控录像。

words.enDefinition: the contestant who wins the contest

examples.en: Everyone cheered loudly when the winner crossed the finish line.
examples.zh: 「获胜者」冲过终点线时，大家都大声欢呼。

examples.en: The raffle winner chose the beach trip over the new laptop.
examples.zh: 抽奖「得主」选了海边旅行，放弃了新笔记本电脑。

words.enDefinition: a person elected to an office who has not yet taken it (used after a title, as in president-elect)

examples.en: The mayor-elect promised to repair every pothole downtown before summer.
examples.zh: 「当选市长」承诺入夏前把市中心的坑洼路都修好。

examples.en: Reporters kept calling the governor-elect's office for interviews all morning.
examples.zh: 记者们一上午都在给「州长当选人」的办公室打电话约采访。

words.enDefinition: reproach for some lapse or misdeed

examples.en: The dog knocked over the vase, but our cat took the blame.
examples.zh: 花瓶其实是狗碰倒的，却让猫「背了黑锅」。

examples.en: The manager accepted the blame for the missing dinner reservation.
examples.zh: 经理为弄丢的晚餐预订「承担了责任」。

words.enDefinition: an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth

examples.en: The mechanic gave us a rough estimate for the engine repair.
examples.zh: 修理工给了我们一份发动机维修的粗略「估价」。

examples.en: By my estimate, moving all these boxes will take three days.
examples.zh: 据我「估计」，搬完这些箱子要花三天。

words.enDefinition: (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon

examples.en: The patchwork quilt has a bright red square in every corner.
examples.zh: 拼布被子的每个角上都有一块鲜红的「正方形」。

examples.en: Draw a perfect square first, then divide it into four smaller ones.
examples.zh: 先画一个标准的「正方形」，再把它分成四个小的。

words.enDefinition: formal message requesting something that is submitted to an authority

examples.en: The library approved my request to extend the loan by two weeks.
examples.zh: 图书馆「同意」了我延长借期两周的请求。

examples.en: Song requests poured in as soon as the radio host came on air.
examples.zh: 电台主持人一开播，「点歌请求」就源源不断地涌进来。

words.enDefinition: to leave someone or something out of a group or statement

examples.en: The hotel may except small pets from its usual animal ban.
examples.zh: 这家酒店也许会把小型宠物「排除」在通常的禁宠令之外。

examples.en: The airline will except travelers with medical needs from the new baggage fee.
examples.zh: 航空公司会把有医疗需求的旅客「除外」，不收新增的行李费。

words.enDefinition: at the same time but in another place

examples.en: The pasta needs ten minutes; meanwhile, I will chop the garlic.
examples.zh: 意面要煮十分钟；「与此同时」，我来切蒜。

examples.en: Dad was still parking the car; meanwhile, we queued for ferry tickets.
examples.zh: 爸爸还在停车；「与此同时」，我们排着队买船票。

words.enDefinition: large and impressive in physical size or extent

examples.en: The wedding took place in a grand ballroom with crystal chandeliers.
examples.zh: 婚礼在一间挂着水晶吊灯的「华丽」宴会厅里举行。

examples.en: We stood amazed in front of the palace's grand entrance.
examples.zh: 我们站在宫殿「宏伟」的入口前，惊叹不已。

words.enDefinition: a popular style of clothing, hair, or behavior at a given time

examples.en: Wide-leg jeans have come back into fashion among college students.
examples.zh: 阔腿牛仔裤今年又在大学生中间「流行」起来。

examples.en: My sister follows every new fashion, from colors to hairstyles.
examples.zh: 从配色到发型，我妹妹追逐每一种新「时尚」。

words.enDefinition: the land along the edge of the sea or ocean

examples.en: We drove along the coast and stopped at every quiet beach.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「海岸」开车，每处安静的海滩都停下来看看。

examples.en: The whole coast was foggy this morning, so the ferry moved slowly.
examples.zh: 今早整段「海岸」都雾蒙蒙的，渡轮开得很慢。

words.enDefinition: express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness

examples.en: Guests complained about the noise from the construction site next door.
examples.zh: 客人们「抱怨」隔壁工地传来的噪音。

examples.en: He always complains about the weather but never carries an umbrella.
examples.zh: 他总是「抱怨」天气，却从不带伞。

words.enDefinition: a short written summary or set of instructions for a task or case

examples.en: The designer read the brief twice before sketching the new logo.
examples.zh: 动笔画新标志之前，设计师把那份「简报」读了两遍。

examples.en: Each student prepared a one-page brief on climate change for the debate.
examples.zh: 每个学生都为辩论准备了一页关于气候变化的「摘要」。

words.enDefinition: something that should remain hidden from others (especially information that is not to be passed on)

examples.en: The kids kept the surprise party a secret from Mom all week.
examples.zh: 整整一周，孩子们都把惊喜派对当作「秘密」瞒着妈妈。

examples.en: Grandma finally shared her secret for making the fluffiest pancakes.
examples.zh: 奶奶终于把做出最松软煎饼的「秘诀」告诉了我们。

words.enDefinition: forward movement or progress; also money paid before it is due

examples.en: She received an advance from the publisher for her first cookbook.
examples.zh: 她拿到了出版社为首本食谱书支付的「预付款」。

examples.en: Despite the storm, the rescue team made a steady advance up the slope.
examples.zh: 尽管风暴肆虐，救援队仍沿着山坡稳步「推进」。

words.enDefinition: bring an accusation against; level a charge against

examples.en: My sister accused me of eating the last slice of cake.
examples.zh: 妹妹「指责」我吃了最后一块蛋糕。

examples.en: Neighbors accused the old factory of polluting the small river nearby.
examples.zh: 邻居们「指控」那家老工厂污染了附近的小河。

words.enDefinition: machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical energy and so imparts motion

examples.en: The old fan's motor hums loudly whenever it runs for an hour.
examples.zh: 旧风扇的「马达」一转满一小时就嗡嗡作响。

examples.en: Dad replaced the washing machine motor himself and saved a repair fee.
examples.zh: 爸爸自己换了洗衣机的「马达」，省下一笔修理费。

words.enDefinition: quantity that does not vary

examples.en: In physics class, gravity is treated as a fixed constant in every formula.
examples.zh: 物理课上，重力在所有公式里都被当作固定的「常数」。

examples.en: Our teacher said pi is the most famous constant in mathematics.
examples.zh: 老师说圆周率是数学里最著名的「常数」。

words.enDefinition: the idea of something that is perfect; something that one hopes to attain

examples.en: Moving to the countryside and keeping bees has always been her ideal.
examples.zh: 搬到乡下养蜜蜂一直是她的「理想」。

examples.en: He gave up a high salary to pursue his ideal of teaching.
examples.zh: 他放弃了高薪，去追求当老师的「理想」。

words.enDefinition: pull back or move away or backward

examples.en: Grandpa walked to the bank to withdraw cash for the weekend trip.
examples.zh: 爷爷步行去银行「提取」周末旅行要用的现金。

examples.en: The company withdrew its controversial ad after customers complained online.
examples.zh: 顾客在网上投诉后，公司「撤回」了那条有争议的广告。

words.enDefinition: intensely or extremely bad or unpleasant in degree or quality

examples.en: The severe storm knocked down trees across the whole neighborhood.
examples.zh: 这场「猛烈」的暴风雨刮倒了整个街区的许多树木。

examples.en: Grandpa felt severe chest pain, so we called the doctor at once.
examples.zh: 爷爷胸口「剧烈」疼痛，我们立刻请了医生。

words.enDefinition: causing fear or dread or terror

examples.en: The traffic was terrible this morning, so I missed my first class.
examples.zh: 今天早上交通「糟透了」，所以我误了第一节课。

examples.en: The horror movie had one terrible scene that made everyone scream.
examples.zh: 那部恐怖片里有个「可怕」的场景，把所有人都吓得尖叫。

words.enDefinition: person who is confined; especially a prisoner of war

examples.en: In the story, the prisoner dug a tunnel over three long years.
examples.zh: 故事里，那名「囚犯」花了整整三年挖出一条地道。

examples.en: Guards counted the prisoners twice before locking the yard for the night.
examples.zh: 狱警在夜里锁院子前把「囚犯」们清点了两遍。

words.enDefinition: someone who has committed a crime or has been legally convicted of a crime

examples.en: The detective studied the blurry photo carefully to identify the criminal.
examples.zh: 侦探仔细研究那张模糊的照片，来确认「罪犯」的身份。

examples.en: My cousin watches crime shows and always guesses the criminal first.
examples.zh: 我表哥看罪案剧时总是最先猜出「罪犯」。

words.enDefinition: live (in a certain place)

examples.en: The new bakery occupies the corner shop where the post office used to be.
examples.zh: 新面包店「占据」了原来邮局所在的街角小店。

examples.en: Homework and piano lessons occupy most of my weekday evenings.
examples.zh: 作业和钢琴课「占」去了我工作日晚上大部分时间。

words.enDefinition: a violent collision or impact; also a sudden unpleasant surprise or an electric discharge

examples.en: The shock of the explosion shattered windows three streets away.
examples.zh: 爆炸的「冲击」震碎了三条街外的玻璃窗。

examples.en: Grandma got a small shock when she touched the old heater.
examples.zh: 奶奶碰到旧取暖器时被轻微「电」了一下。

words.enDefinition: change toward something smaller or lower

examples.en: The village has seen a steady decline in young residents since the mill closed.
examples.zh: 磨坊关闭后，村里的年轻居民持续「减少」。

examples.en: Doctors noticed a slow decline in his hearing after the concert.
examples.zh: 音乐会后，医生发现他的听力慢慢「衰退」。

words.enDefinition: the sensation that results when taste buds in the tongue and throat convey information about the chemical composition of a soluble stimulus

examples.en: One sip of grandma's soup brought back the taste of childhood.
examples.zh: 一口奶奶做的汤，唤回了童年的「味道」。

examples.en: This lemon cake has a sharp taste that wakes up your mouth.
examples.zh: 这款柠檬蛋糕有种尖锐的「味道」，一下子唤醒了味蕾。

words.enDefinition: musical notation indicating one half step higher than the note named

examples.en: The pianist mistakenly played every F as a sharp in the second verse.
examples.zh: 弹到第二段时，钢琴家误把每个 F 都弹成了「升音」。

examples.en: Our music teacher drew a sharp in front of the note on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 音乐老师在白板上那个音符前面画了一个「升记号」。

words.enDefinition: be in control

examples.en: The older boys dominate the basketball court every lunch break.
examples.zh: 每天午休，高年级男生总是「称霸」篮球场。

examples.en: One strong swimmer dominated the relay from the very first lap.
examples.zh: 从第一圈起，接力赛就被那位健将「主导」了。

words.enDefinition: something added; the process of adding numbers or items

examples.en: The new balcony is a lovely addition to our small flat.
examples.zh: 新阳台是我们这套小公寓里讨人喜欢的「新增部分」。

examples.en: In addition to the fruit, the gift box also holds a jar of honey.
examples.zh: 「除」水果「外」，礼盒里还装着一罐蜂蜜。

words.enDefinition: writer for newspapers and magazines

examples.en: The young journalist interviewed vendors at the night market for her column.
examples.zh: 那位年轻「记者」为专栏采访了夜市的小贩。

examples.en: A sports journalist waited outside the stadium for the coach's comments.
examples.zh: 一位体育「记者」在体育场外等着教练发表评论。

words.enDefinition: someone who is under suspicion

examples.en: The police questioned one suspect for hours about the missing bicycle.
examples.zh: 警方就失踪的自行车盘问了那名「嫌疑人」好几个小时。

examples.en: In the mystery novel, the quiet neighbor was the least likely suspect.
examples.zh: 在推理小说里，安静的邻居是最不可能的「嫌疑人」。

words.enDefinition: bar from attention or consideration

examples.en: The doctor quickly dismissed my fear that the cough was serious.
examples.zh: 医生很快「否定」了我担心咳嗽很严重的想法。

examples.en: The judge dismissed the case because the evidence was clearly incomplete.
examples.zh: 由于证据明显不足，法官「驳回」了这起案件。

words.enDefinition: suitable to or characteristic of drama

examples.en: The sky turned a dramatic orange just before the storm hit.
examples.zh: 暴风雨来临前，天空呈现出「戏剧性」的橙色。

examples.en: The final episode had a dramatic twist nobody in the family expected.
examples.zh: 大结局的「戏剧性」转折出乎全家人的意料。

words.enDefinition: something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery

examples.en: The spelling bee's first prize is a full set of encyclopedias.
examples.zh: 拼字比赛的头「奖」是一整套百科全书。

examples.en: Grandma won a small prize in the village lottery for the third time.
examples.zh: 奶奶第三次在村里的抽奖中得了个小「奖品」。

words.enDefinition: the act of taking someone into legal custody; the state of being detained by police

examples.en: The thief's arrest surprised neighbors who thought he was just a handyman.
examples.zh: 那名窃贼被「逮捕」时，邻居们很吃惊，本以为他只是个修理工。

examples.en: Reporters crowded the courthouse as soon as news of the arrest spread.
examples.zh: 「逮捕」的消息一传开，记者们就挤满了法院门口。

words.enDefinition: an ordered list of times at which things are planned to occur

examples.en: The train schedule on the wall helped us plan the whole day trip.
examples.zh: 墙上的火车「时刻表」帮我们计划了一整天的行程。

examples.en: Mom stuck the family schedule on the fridge so nobody misses practice.
examples.zh: 妈妈把全家的「日程表」贴在冰箱上，谁也不会错过训练。

words.enDefinition: the acquisition of something for payment

examples.en: Keep the receipt for every purchase so returns stay easy.
examples.zh: 每次「购买」都保留收据，退货就会很方便。

examples.en: My first big purchase after payday was a warm winter coat.
examples.zh: 发工资后，我的第一笔大「购物」是一件暖和的冬衣。

words.enDefinition: the text appearing in a book, newspaper, or other printed publication

examples.en: The small print at the bottom of the contract mentions a yearly fee.
examples.zh: 合同底部密密的「小字印刷」里提到一笔年费。

examples.en: Grandma prefers books with large print because reading glasses strain her eyes.
examples.zh: 奶奶偏爱「大字印刷」的书，因为戴老花镜看字很费眼。

words.enDefinition: formal and solemn declaration of objection

examples.en: Students held a peaceful protest against cutting the school sports budget.
examples.zh: 学生们举行和平「抗议」，反对削减学校的体育预算。

examples.en: Despite our protest, the landlord raised the parking fee again.
examples.zh: 尽管我们「抗议」，房东还是又上调了停车费。

words.enDefinition: commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country

examples.en: Tea is this island's most famous export to markets across Europe.
examples.zh: 茶叶是这座岛销往欧洲市场的最著名「出口商品」。

examples.en: Farmers packed the season's oranges, ready for export to neighboring countries.
examples.zh: 果农把本季的橙子装箱，准备「出口」到邻国。

words.enDefinition: day or period of time set aside for feasting and celebration

examples.en: Red lanterns gave the whole street a festival look before New Year.
examples.zh: 新年前，红灯笼让整条街都透着「节日」的气氛。

examples.en: Everyone wore festival clothes for the harvest celebration in the village.
examples.zh: 村里的丰收庆典上，大家都穿上了「节日的」盛装。

words.enDefinition: happening or moving very quickly; fast

examples.en: The city's rapid growth turned farmland into apartment blocks within a decade.
examples.zh: 城市的「迅速」扩张让农田在十年间变成了公寓楼。

examples.en: Her rapid recovery surprised the doctors after such a serious fall.
examples.zh: 摔得那么重，她却「迅速」康复，医生们都感到惊讶。

words.enDefinition: cloud of fine particles suspended in a gas

examples.en: Thin smoke drifted from the neighbor's chimney into our yard.
examples.zh: 淡淡的「烟」从邻居家的烟囱飘进了我们的院子。

examples.en: We saw smoke rising from the kitchen and rushed to check the pan.
examples.zh: 看见厨房冒「烟」，我们赶紧跑去查看锅子。

words.enDefinition: an informal word for a man or boy; an associate or companion

examples.en: That friendly fellow at the bus stop shares his umbrella every rainy day.
examples.zh: 公交站那个友善的「家伙」，一到雨天就与人共用雨伞。

examples.en: My grandfather still writes to an old fellow from his army days.
examples.zh: 祖父还和一位当兵时的老「伙伴」保持着书信往来。

words.enDefinition: an example or occurrence of something

examples.en: This delay is one more instance of the ferry running late in fog.
examples.zh: 这次延误又是渡轮在雾中晚点的又一个「例子」。

examples.en: In some instances, the bakery sells day-old bread at half price.
examples.zh: 在有些「情况」下，面包店会把隔天的面包半价出售。

words.enDefinition: something kept back or saved for future use or a special purpose

examples.en: Grandma keeps a reserve of canned food in case of heavy snow.
examples.zh: 奶奶储存了一批罐头「储备」，以防大雪封门。

examples.en: The camp's water reserve nearly ran dry during the hot week.
examples.zh: 炎热的那一周，营地的「储水」几乎见了底。

words.enDefinition: written assurance that some product or service will be provided or will meet certain specifications

examples.en: The washing machine still has a two-year guarantee from the store.
examples.zh: 这台洗衣机还有商店提供的两年「保修」。

examples.en: The seller gave a written guarantee that the puppy had all its shots.
examples.zh: 卖家书面「保证」这只小狗已经打齐了疫苗。

words.enDefinition: a person or thing that one likes best or favors above all others

examples.en: Strawberry ice cream has been my favourite since primary school.
examples.zh: 草莓冰淇淋从小学起就是我的「最爱」。

examples.en: This old song remains the family's favourite at every birthday dinner.
examples.zh: 每逢生日聚餐，这首老歌仍是全家的「最爱」。

words.enDefinition: time during which some action is awaited

examples.en: A short delay at the station made us miss the first ferry.
examples.zh: 车站的小「延误」让我们错过了第一班渡轮。

examples.en: After a long delay, the repairman finally arrived with the right part.
examples.zh: 「耽搁」了很久之后，修理工终于带着合适的零件来了。

words.enDefinition: the form in which a text (especially a printed book) is published

examples.en: The library keeps every edition of the town newspaper since 1950.
examples.zh: 图书馆收藏着这家镇报自 1950 年以来的每一「版」。

examples.en: My pocket dictionary is a newer edition with clearer examples.
examples.zh: 我的袖珍词典是例句更清晰的新「版本」。

words.enDefinition: material produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in atoms or molecules

examples.en: The lab class showed how a simple chemical turns purple cabbage juice red.
examples.zh: 实验课上我们看到一种简单的「化学药品」把紫甘蓝汁变红了。

examples.en: Farmers now use fewer chemicals to keep the stream water clean.
examples.zh: 为了保持溪水清洁，农民现在少用「化学品」了。

words.enDefinition: an unsuccessful ending to a struggle or contest

examples.en: The chess club's first defeat in two years surprised everyone at school.
examples.zh: 棋社两年来的首次「失利」让全校都感到意外。

examples.en: Even after the defeat, the team kept training every rainy evening.
examples.zh: 即便遭遇「失败」，球队仍坚持在雨天的傍晚训练。

words.enDefinition: extending the legs at right angles to the trunk (one in front and the other in back)

examples.en: The gymnast held a perfect split during her floor routine.
examples.zh: 体操选手在自由体操中完成了一个标准的「劈叉」。

examples.en: After months of stretching, Mia finally touched the floor in a full split.
examples.zh: 拉伸了几个月后，米娅终于能完全「劈叉」触地了。

words.enDefinition: creation of the highest excellence

examples.en: Sherlock Holmes is a classic that my whole family rereads every winter.
examples.zh: 《福尔摩斯》是全家每年冬天都会重读的「经典」。

examples.en: That old film is a real classic, still funny after fifty years.
examples.zh: 那部老电影是真正的「经典」，五十年后依然好笑。

words.enDefinition: farm building for housing horses or other livestock

examples.en: Every morning before school, Mia helps groom horses in the stable.
examples.zh: 上学前，米娅每天早上都会帮着在「马厩」里给马梳洗。

examples.en: The old wooden stable smells of hay and warm leather in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天，老木「马厩」里满是干草和暖皮革的味道。

words.enDefinition: female member of a royal family other than the queen (especially the daughter of a sovereign)

examples.en: At the school play, my little sister played a lost princess.
examples.zh: 校园剧里，我妹妹扮演了一位迷路的「公主」。

examples.en: The storybook tells how a brave princess rescued the village from the dragon.
examples.zh: 故事书讲述勇敢的「公主」如何从恶龙手中救下村庄。

words.enDefinition: the child of your aunt or uncle

examples.en: My cousin from Toronto is visiting us during the summer holidays.
examples.zh: 多伦多的「表哥」暑假会来我们家住。

examples.en: At the reunion, my cousins taught me a card game from their hometown.
examples.zh: 家庭聚会上，「表兄妹们」教了我一种他们家乡的纸牌游戏。

words.enDefinition: commodities (goods or services) bought from a foreign country

examples.en: The shop's best-selling import is the dark chocolate made in Belgium.
examples.zh: 这家店最畅销的「进口商品」是比利时产的黑巧克力。

examples.en: Rice is a major import for countries with little farmland.
examples.zh: 对耕地稀少的国家来说，大米是重要的「进口货」。

words.enDefinition: feeling of favorable regard

examples.en: Her kindness to new students earned her the favour of every teacher.
examples.zh: 她对新同学的友善让她赢得了每位老师的「好感」。

examples.en: The cafe's quiet corners are in favour with students before exams.
examples.zh: 考试前，咖啡馆安静的角落很受学生「青睐」。

words.enDefinition: serious accident (usually involving one or more vehicles)

examples.en: Nobody was hurt in the car crash at the snowy crossing last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚雪天路口的「车祸」中没有人受伤。

examples.en: The news showed photos of the plane crash near the mountain village.
examples.zh: 新闻展示了山村附近「坠机」事故的照片。

words.enDefinition: the contestant you hope to defeat

examples.en: Our school's biggest rival in the football league is Riverside High.
examples.zh: 足球联赛中我们学校最大的「对手」是河滨高中。

examples.en: The chess champion greeted her old rival with a warm handshake.
examples.zh: 国际象棋冠军与老「对手」热情握手致意。

words.enDefinition: an abrupt failure of function or complete physical exhaustion

examples.en: The bridge's collapse cut off the only road into the valley.
examples.zh: 大桥的「坍塌」切断了进入山谷的唯一公路。

examples.en: After the marathon, his collapse at the finish line worried the medics.
examples.zh: 马拉松结束后，他在终点的「虚脱倒地」让医护人员很担心。

words.enDefinition: occurring or done often at short intervals; happening repeatedly

examples.en: Our frequent visits to grandma's house always end with her dumplings.
examples.zh: 我们对奶奶家的「频繁」拜访，总以她包的饺子收场。

examples.en: The frequent bus service means you never wait long at this stop.
examples.zh: 公交班次「频繁」，在这个站等车从不用太久。

words.enDefinition: marked by strict and particular and complete accordance with fact

examples.en: Do you know the exact time the night market opens on Fridays?
examples.zh: 你知道夜市周五「确切」的开放时间吗？

examples.en: The map shows the exact spot where the old lighthouse stood.
examples.zh: 地图上标出了旧灯塔所在「确切」的位置。

words.enDefinition: an investigation of the component parts of a whole and their relations in making up the whole

examples.en: After a careful analysis of her diet, the coach suggested more protein.
examples.zh: 仔细「分析」了她的饮食后，教练建议多补充蛋白质。

examples.en: Grandma's analysis of the neighbors' quarrel turned out to be right.
examples.zh: 奶奶对邻居吵架原因的「分析」结果证明是对的。

words.enDefinition: give an account of

examples.en: Grandpa loves to relate stories of his voyage around the cape.
examples.zh: 祖父喜欢「讲」他绕过好望角航行的故事。

examples.en: The witness agreed to relate the events of that rainy evening.
examples.zh: 证人同意「讲述」那个雨夜发生的事情。

words.enDefinition: indicating exactness or preciseness

examples.en: Please arrive at eight exactly, because the ferry leaves without waiting.
examples.zh: 请「正好」八点到，渡轮可不等人。

examples.en: That's exactly what Mom said when I broke the old vase.
examples.zh: 我打碎旧花瓶时，妈妈「正是」这么说的。

words.enDefinition: examine and note the similarities or differences of

examples.en: Before buying a phone, compare prices at three different shops.
examples.zh: 买手机前，先在三家店「比较」一下价格。

examples.en: My little brother loves to compare his toy cars by speed.
examples.zh: 弟弟喜欢按速度「比较」他的玩具小车。

words.enDefinition: come into possession of

examples.en: You must obtain permission before hanging posters in the hallway.
examples.zh: 在走廊贴海报之前，你必须先「获得」许可。

examples.en: Students can obtain a free copy of the guide from the front desk.
examples.zh: 学生可以在前台「取得」免费的指南副本。

words.enDefinition: characterized by unity; being or joined into a single entity

examples.en: The united efforts of the neighbors cleaned the beach in one morning.
examples.zh: 邻居们「齐心协力」，一个上午就把海滩清理干净了。

examples.en: A united class presentation impressed everyone at the science fair.
examples.zh: 全班「齐心」完成的展示在科学展上让所有人赞叹。

words.enDefinition: particular course of action intended to achieve a result

examples.en: The nurse explained the check-in procedure to every new patient.
examples.zh: 护士向每位新病人解释了「登记流程」。

examples.en: Follow the safety procedure before turning on the welding machine.
examples.zh: 打开焊机之前，请遵守「安全操作规程」。

words.enDefinition: condition that accompanies or influences some event or activity

examples.en: In no circumstance should you swim in this river after dark.
examples.zh: 天黑之后，任何「情况」下都不许在这条河里游泳。

examples.en: Each team's circumstances differ, so practice times will vary this season.
examples.zh: 每支队伍的「情况」不同，所以本赛季的训练时间会有变化。

words.enDefinition: person who seeks the advice of a lawyer

examples.en: The barber knows each client's preferred cut after twenty years downtown.
examples.zh: 在市中心干了二十年，理发师记得每位「顾客」爱好的发型。

examples.en: The lawyer explained the contract to her client in plain words.
examples.zh: 律师用平实的语言向「委托人」解释了合同。

words.enDefinition: means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information

examples.en: Radio remains a trusted medium for farmers waiting on weather news.
examples.zh: 对等着天气消息的农民来说，广播仍是可信的「媒介」。

examples.en: Clay is a popular medium in our Thursday pottery workshop.
examples.zh: 陶土是我们周四陶艺工作坊常用的一种「材料」。

words.enDefinition: the point or degree to which something extends

examples.en: To some extent, the delay was caused by the heavy fog.
examples.zh: 这次延误在「一定程度上」是由大雾造成的。

examples.en: The extent of the fire damage shocked the whole neighborhood.
examples.zh: 火灾损毁的「范围」震惊了整个街区。

words.enDefinition: render capable or able for some task

examples.en: The new ramp enables wheelchair users to enter the library alone.
examples.zh: 新坡道使轮椅使用者「能够」独自进出图书馆。

examples.en: Saving money this year will enable us to visit grandmother in spring.
examples.zh: 今年攒下的钱将使我们「能够」在春天去看望祖母。

words.enDefinition: someone who expresses in language; someone who talks (especially someone who delivers a public speech or someone especially garrulous)

examples.en: The main speaker at the book fair signed copies after her talk.
examples.zh: 书展的「主讲人」演讲结束后为读者签名。

examples.en: At the debate, each speaker had exactly three minutes to argue.
examples.zh: 辩论会上，每位「发言者」恰好有三分钟陈述时间。

words.enDefinition: the right or opportunity to use or reach something

examples.en: Members get early access to the gym before it opens to the public.
examples.zh: 健身房对公众开放前，会员可「优先使用」。

examples.en: The side ramp gives wheelchair users easy access to the stage.
examples.zh: 侧边的坡道让轮椅使用者可以轻松「进入」舞台区。

words.enDefinition: with ease (`easy' is sometimes used informally for `easily')

examples.en: Grandpa climbs the stairs easily now after his knee surgery.
examples.zh: 膝盖手术后，爷爷现在上下楼梯很「轻松」。

examples.en: These new shoes slip on easily, even without untying the laces.
examples.zh: 这双新鞋「很容易」穿，甚至不用解鞋带。

words.enDefinition: a note or source used to find information; the act of referring to something

examples.en: Keep the page number as a reference when you cite the article.
examples.zh: 引用这篇文章时，把页码留作「参考」。

examples.en: The map in the guide is a handy reference for hikers.
examples.zh: 指南里的地图是徒步者随手可查的「参考资料」。

words.enDefinition: discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation

examples.en: Guess the meaning of the new word from its context in the story.
examples.zh: 从故事的「上下文」里猜猜这个生词的意思。

examples.en: Out of context, his joke sounded ruder than he intended.
examples.zh: 脱离「语境」来看，他的玩笑听起来比本意生硬。

words.enDefinition: arousing or holding the attention

examples.en: The museum's new dinosaur exhibit is interesting for both kids and adults.
examples.zh: 博物馆新开的恐龙展对大人和孩子都「有趣」。

examples.en: She told us an interesting story about her grandmother's sea voyage.
examples.zh: 她给我们讲了一个关于祖母海上旅行的「有趣」故事。

words.enDefinition: the activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information

examples.en: Good communication between roommates prevents most of the small arguments.
examples.zh: 室友间良好的「沟通」能避免大多数小争执。

examples.en: Video calls have become our main communication with cousins overseas.
examples.zh: 视频通话成了我们与海外表亲主要的「交流」方式。

words.enDefinition: originate or come into being

examples.en: New problems often arise when the whole family travels together.
examples.zh: 全家一起旅行时，常会「出现」新的问题。

examples.en: If any confusion arises during checkout, ask the receptionist for help.
examples.zh: 退房时若「出现」疑问，可以请前台帮忙。

words.enDefinition: give a definition for the meaning of a word

examples.en: Can you define courage without using the word brave at all?
examples.zh: 你能完全不用 brave 这个词来「定义」courage 吗？

examples.en: House rules clearly define which chores each child handles every week.
examples.zh: 家规明确「规定」了每个孩子每周负责哪些家务。

words.enDefinition: (computer science) written programs or procedures or rules and associated documentation pertaining to the operation of a computer system and that are stored in read/write memory

examples.en: This free software lets students edit audio for their podcasts.
examples.zh: 这款免费「软件」让学生可以编辑播客音频。

examples.en: The laptop came with drawing software preinstalled for my art class.
examples.zh: 这台笔记本电脑预装了绘画「软件」，供我上美术课用。

words.enDefinition: an orderly grouping (of things or persons) considered as a unit; the result of arranging

examples.en: The flower arrangement on the dining table uses only garden roses.
examples.zh: 餐桌上的「插花」只用了花园里种的玫瑰。

examples.en: The librarian approved our new seating arrangement for story hour.
examples.zh: 图书管理员同意了我们为故事时间做的「座位安排」。

words.enDefinition: the trees and other plants in a large densely wooded area

examples.en: The hiking trail winds through a forest of tall cedar trees.
examples.zh: 这条徒步小径蜿蜒穿过一片高大的雪松「森林」。

examples.en: Birds wake the whole forest every morning just before sunrise.
examples.zh: 每天日出前，鸟儿唤醒整片「森林」。

words.enDefinition: involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope

examples.en: Global sea levels rise a little every year, coastal towns report.
examples.zh: 沿海城镇报告说，「全球」海平面每年都在缓慢上升。

examples.en: The band's global tour includes stops in twelve countries this summer.
examples.zh: 乐队今夏的「全球」巡演将在十二个国家停留。

words.enDefinition: fixed look with eyes open wide

examples.en: Don't stare at the sun during the eclipse without special glasses.
examples.zh: 日食期间，不戴专用眼镜不要「直视」太阳。

examples.en: The whole cafe seemed to stare when the musician dropped his trumpet.
examples.zh: 乐手的小号掉落时，整个咖啡馆的人似乎都在「盯着看」。

words.enDefinition: the feelings expressed on a person's face

examples.en: Grandma's proud expression showed the moment I recited the poem perfectly.
examples.zh: 我完美背出那首诗的那一刻，奶奶脸上满是骄傲的「表情」。

examples.en: That old saying is a common expression in southern villages.
examples.zh: 那句老话是南方村庄里常用的「说法」。

words.enDefinition: an informal talk between two or more people

examples.en: An easy conversation with the taxi driver made the long ride shorter.
examples.zh: 与出租车司机轻松的「闲聊」让漫长的车程变短了。

examples.en: Grandma started a conversation with every neighbor at the market.
examples.zh: 在市场里，奶奶跟每位邻居都「聊」了起来。

words.enDefinition: preliminary election where delegates or nominees are chosen

examples.en: Voters in our town choose the mayoral candidates in the primary.
examples.zh: 我们镇的选民在「初选」中挑选市长候选人。

examples.en: Campaign volunteers knocked on doors across town before the April primary.
examples.zh: 四月「初选」前，竞选志愿者在镇上挨家挨户敲门拉票。

words.enDefinition: division of some larger or more complex organization

examples.en: The new library branch opened two blocks from the train station.
examples.zh: 新的图书馆「分馆」开在距火车站两个街区的地方。

examples.en: Our bank's branch on Main Street closes early on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 我们银行在大街上的「分行」周六关门较早。

words.enDefinition: under normal conditions

examples.en: The bakery normally opens at seven, but today it stayed shut.
examples.zh: 面包店「通常」七点开门，但今天一直没开。

examples.en: Grandpa normally walks the dog after dinner, rain or shine.
examples.zh: 爷爷「通常」晚饭后遛狗，风雨无阻。

words.enDefinition: an implement consisting of a length of wood

examples.en: The retriever dove into the lake to fetch the wooden stick.
examples.zh: 那只寻回犬跳进湖里去捡木「棍」。

examples.en: Grandpa taught us to roast marshmallows on a long stick.
examples.zh: 爷爷教我们把棉花糖串在长「棍」上烤。

words.enDefinition: person who joins with others in some activity or endeavor

examples.en: Uncle Ray and his associates run the fishing charter business together.
examples.zh: 雷叔叔和他的生意「伙伴」一起经营包船钓鱼生意。

examples.en: He met his old associates from the band at the reunion.
examples.zh: 在重聚会上，他见到了乐队当年的老「伙伴」。

words.enDefinition: vivid mental image

examples.en: Opening a small bakery by the sea has been her clear vision.
examples.zh: 在海边开一家小面包店是她心中清晰的「愿景」。

examples.en: In his vision, the garden was full of white roses again.
examples.zh: 在他的「想象」中，花园里又开满了白玫瑰。

words.enDefinition: the state of being employed or having a job

examples.en: Both brothers are in the employ of the same shipping company.
examples.zh: 兄弟俩都「受雇于」同一家船运公司。

examples.en: She left the family's employ to open her own dress shop.
examples.zh: 她离开了那家人的「雇用」，自己开了一家裁缝店。

words.enDefinition: phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon

examples.en: Skipping breakfast has a quick consequence: you feel hungry halfway through class.
examples.zh: 不吃早饭有个直接的「后果」：上课到一半就饿了。

examples.en: As a consequence of the storm, the market closed two hours early.
examples.zh: 风暴的「后果」之一，是市场提前两小时关门。

words.enDefinition: an automotive vehicle suitable for hauling

examples.en: The farmer loads his truck with pumpkins before dawn every Friday.
examples.zh: 每周五天亮前，农民都把南瓜装上「卡车」。

examples.en: A delivery truck blocked our narrow street for almost an hour.
examples.zh: 一辆送货「卡车」把我们这条窄街堵了将近一小时。

words.enDefinition: having a bearing on or connection with the subject at issue

examples.en: Please bring only relevant documents to tomorrow's meeting with the landlord.
examples.zh: 明天见房东时，请只带「相关」的文件。

examples.en: The history teacher showed how old letters are still relevant today.
examples.zh: 历史老师讲解了旧信件为何至今仍有「现实关联」。

words.enDefinition: an inherited pattern of thought or action

examples.en: Every New Year, our family keeps the tradition of hand-making dumplings.
examples.zh: 每逢新年，我们家都保留手工包饺子的「传统」。

examples.en: The village tradition of lighting lanterns on Mid-Autumn night continues.
examples.zh: 中秋夜点灯笼的村庄「传统」一直延续着。

words.enDefinition: the coldest season of the year; in the northern hemisphere it extends from the winter solstice to the vernal equinox

examples.en: In winter, the whole family gathers around the fireplace after dinner.
examples.zh: 「冬天」，全家人晚饭后围坐在壁炉边。

examples.en: This winter is colder than last, so the pond froze early.
examples.zh: 今年「冬季」比去年冷，池塘早早结了冰。

words.enDefinition: the quotient obtained when the magnitude of a part is divided by the magnitude of the whole

examples.en: Mix the cement with water in a proportion of three to one.
examples.zh: 水泥与水按三比一的「比例」混合。

examples.en: A surprisingly large proportion of the town watches the lantern parade.
examples.zh: 镇上看灯会的人占了「相当大」的比例。

words.enDefinition: the second of two or the second mentioned of two

examples.en: The latter half of the movie had everyone in tears.
examples.zh: 电影的「后半」部分让所有人都流泪了。

examples.en: We visited the museum first and the aquarium in the latter part of the day.
examples.zh: 我们先逛博物馆，一天的「后半段」去了水族馆。

words.enDefinition: concerned with actual use or practice

examples.en: Mom keeps a practical first-aid kit in every car we own.
examples.zh: 我们的每辆车里，妈妈都备着一个「实用的」急救包。

examples.en: Practical shoes matter more than pretty ones on a mountain hike.
examples.zh: 爬山时，「实用的」鞋比好看的鞋更重要。

words.enDefinition: create and charge with a task or function

examples.en: The council will appoint a new librarian before the spring term.
examples.zh: 委员会将在春季学期开始前「任命」一位新图书管理员。

examples.en: Members appointed Uncle Sam to lead the festival committee this year.
examples.zh: 成员们「委任」山姆叔叔担任今年的节日委员会主任。

words.enDefinition: suite of rooms usually on one floor of an apartment house

examples.en: Their new apartment has a balcony facing the morning market.
examples.zh: 他们的新「公寓」有个朝着早市的阳台。

examples.en: We painted the apartment's living room a soft green last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末我们把「公寓」的客厅刷成了柔和的绿色。

words.enDefinition: an intuitive assumption

examples.en: After three tests, the mechanic reached a clear conclusion about the engine.
examples.zh: 检测三次之后，修理工对发动机得出了明确的「结论」。

examples.en: The detective's final conclusion surprised everyone at the village meeting.
examples.zh: 侦探最后的「结论」让村里会议上的人都感到意外。

words.enDefinition: watch attentively

examples.en: We sat quietly to observe the herons fishing at dawn.
examples.zh: 我们静静坐下，「观察」黎明时捕鱼的鹭。

examples.en: The doctor observed that my cough improved after two days.
examples.zh: 医生「注意到」我的咳嗽两天后有了好转。

words.enDefinition: any cognitive content held as true

examples.en: Her belief in fair treatment guided every decision at the shop.
examples.zh: 公平对待的「信念」指引着她在店里的每个决定。

examples.en: Old fishermen hold a belief that gulls bring the boats home.
examples.zh: 老渔民怀着海鸥能引船归航的「信念」。

words.enDefinition: contribute to some cause

examples.en: Everyone contributed a favorite dish to the neighborhood's spring potluck.
examples.zh: 社区春季聚餐上，每人都「贡献」了一道拿手菜。

examples.en: Regular reading contributes to a richer vocabulary over the years.
examples.zh: 常年坚持阅读「有助于」词汇越来越丰富。

words.enDefinition: the goal or aim that one works toward

examples.en: Our main objective this season is finishing the community garden.
examples.zh: 我们这一季的主要「目标」是建成社区花园。

examples.en: The trainer explained the objective of each drill before practice.
examples.zh: 教练在训练前说明了每项练习的「目的」。

words.enDefinition: the distinct personality of an individual regarded as a persisting entity

examples.en: Check your identity card at the library desk before borrowing.
examples.zh: 借书前请在前台出示「身份」证件。

examples.en: Moving abroad at seventeen made him think hard about his cultural identity.
examples.zh: 十七岁出国让他认真思考起自己的文化「身份」。

words.enDefinition: unit of instruction

examples.en: The piano lesson moved to Thursday because of the holiday.
examples.zh: 因为假期，钢琴「课」改到了周四。

examples.en: Grandpa's fishing lesson ended with tea and stories by the river.
examples.zh: 祖父的钓鱼「课」以河边的茶和故事收尾。

words.enDefinition: complete confidence in a person or plan etc

examples.en: We kept faith that the lost dog would find its way home.
examples.zh: 我们「坚信」走失的狗会自己找回家。

examples.en: The coach's faith in the young keeper never wavered after that mistake.
examples.zh: 那次失误后，教练对年轻门将的「信任」从未动摇。

words.enDefinition: despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)

examples.en: The ferry was delayed by fog; nevertheless, we reached the island by noon.
examples.zh: 渡轮因雾延误；「尽管如此」，我们中午前还是到了岛上。

examples.en: The recipe looked difficult; nevertheless, Mia tried it for Dad's birthday.
examples.zh: 食谱看起来很难；「然而」，米娅还是为爸爸的生日试做了。

words.enDefinition: concentrated form of a foodstuff; the bulk is reduced by removing water

examples.en: Add two spoons of orange concentrate to the jug and stir.
examples.zh: 往壶里加两勺橙子「浓缩液」，再搅匀。

examples.en: This tube of tomato concentrate replaces three jars of the fresh sauce.
examples.zh: 这管番茄「浓缩酱」抵得上三罐新鲜酱汁。

words.enDefinition: someone who visits

examples.en: Each visitor to the lighthouse receives a small shell as a gift.
examples.zh: 灯塔的每位「访客」都会得到一个小贝壳作礼物。

examples.en: A familiar visitor knocked at grandma's door every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 每周日早上都有一位熟「客」来敲奶奶家的门。

words.enDefinition: an indefinite or unknown location

examples.en: The old key must be somewhere in the junk drawer downstairs.
examples.zh: 那把旧钥匙一定在楼下某个「地方」的杂物抽屉里。

examples.en: Dad parked the van somewhere near the stadium, but he forgot exactly where.
examples.zh: 爸爸把车停在体育场「附近某处」，却忘了具体位置。

words.enDefinition: how something is done or how it happens

examples.en: The chef folded the dough in a slow, careful manner.
examples.zh: 厨师以缓慢细心的「方式」揉面团。

examples.en: His cheerful manner made the long bus ride feel pleasant.
examples.zh: 他开朗的「态度」让漫长的车程变得愉快。

words.enDefinition: person's social heritage: previous experience or training

examples.en: Tell me your background in cooking before we plan the menu.
examples.zh: 定菜单之前，先跟我说说你烹饪方面的「背景」。

examples.en: In the photo, a red umbrella adds color to the gray background.
examples.zh: 照片里，一把红伞为灰色的「背景」添了色彩。

words.enDefinition: show or explain how something works by giving examples or a demonstration

examples.en: The baker will demonstrate how to twist pretzels at two o'clock.
examples.zh: 面包师两点将「演示」如何拧碱水结。

examples.en: Our coach demonstrated the new stretch before we copied it.
examples.zh: 教练「示范」了新的拉伸动作，然后我们照着做。

words.enDefinition: at an earlier time or formerly

examples.en: We had previously visited Kyoto in autumn, never in rainy June.
examples.zh: 我们「以前」只在秋天去过京都，从未在多雨的六月去过。

examples.en: The dog previously lived on a farm, so sheep don't frighten him.
examples.zh: 这只狗「先前」住在农场，所以不怕羊。

words.enDefinition: strong belief in a supernatural power or powers that control human destiny

examples.en: The museum's new hall shows festivals from every major religion.
examples.zh: 博物馆的新展厅展示了各大「宗教」的节日。

examples.en: Grandma studies world religions with her book club on Tuesdays.
examples.zh: 每逢周二，奶奶和读书会一起研习世界各「宗教」。

words.enDefinition: not special or different in any way; usual

examples.en: It began as an ordinary Tuesday until the kitten appeared.
examples.zh: 这本来是「平常的」一个周二，直到小猫出现。

examples.en: Grandma turns ordinary rice into a feast with her pickles.
examples.zh: 奶奶用自家的泡菜把「普通的」米饭变成盛宴。

words.enDefinition: ask to represent; of legal counsel

examples.en: The family decided to engage a lawyer before signing the lease.
examples.zh: 签租约之前，全家人决定先「聘请」一位律师。

examples.en: The museum engaged a local painter to teach the weekend class.
examples.zh: 博物馆「聘」了一位本地画家来教周末课程。

words.enDefinition: an authoritative rule

examples.en: A new city regulation limits noise after ten at night.
examples.zh: 一项新的城市「规定」限制晚上十点以后的噪音。

examples.en: The pool's safety regulation requires children to swim with adults.
examples.zh: 泳池的「安全规则」要求儿童须由成人陪同游泳。

words.enDefinition: filled with fear or apprehension

examples.en: The puppy is afraid of thunder and hides under the bed.
examples.zh: 小狗「怕」打雷，一打雷就躲到床底下。

examples.en: Don't be afraid to ask the conductor where to change trains.
examples.zh: 别「害怕」向列车员询问该在哪里换乘。

words.enDefinition: to get or gain something, especially by your own effort or over time

examples.en: She acquired a taste for olives during her year in Spain.
examples.zh: 在西班牙的那一年，她「逐渐喜欢上」了橄榄。

examples.en: The library acquired a rare map collection from an old sailor.
examples.zh: 图书馆从一位老水手那里「获得」了一批珍贵地图。

words.enDefinition: without favoring one party, in a fair evenhanded manner

examples.en: Mom split the cake fairly between the twins and their cousin.
examples.zh: 妈妈把蛋糕「公平地」分给了双胞胎和他们的表弟。

examples.en: The drive to the lake is fairly long, so we left early.
examples.zh: 去湖边的车程「相当」长，所以我们早早出发了。

words.enDefinition: general concept that marks divisions or coordinations in a conceptual scheme

examples.en: This shelf groups novels by category: mystery, romance, and history.
examples.zh: 这个书架按「类别」摆放小说：悬疑、言情和历史。

examples.en: Which category does the apple pie enter in the baking contest?
examples.zh: 烘焙比赛里，苹果派参加哪个「类别」？

words.enDefinition: relation between things or events (as in the case of one causing the other or sharing features with it)

examples.en: The train connection at Springfield gives us twenty minutes for coffee.
examples.zh: 在斯普林菲尔德的「换乘」留给我们二十分钟喝咖啡。

examples.en: Scientists found a connection between sleep and memory in children.
examples.zh: 科学家发现了儿童睡眠与记忆之间的「关联」。

words.enDefinition: the aggregation of things (pedestrians or vehicles) coming and going in a particular locality during a specified period of time

examples.en: Morning traffic near the school doubles once the term starts.
examples.zh: 学期一开始，学校附近的早晨「车流」就翻倍。

examples.en: We took the metro to skip the traffic around the stadium.
examples.zh: 我们坐地铁，避开体育场周围的「交通拥堵」。

words.enDefinition: relative position or degree of value in a graded group

examples.en: The builder chooses timber of a higher grade for outdoor stairs.
examples.zh: 建造者为室外楼梯选用更高「等级」的木材。

examples.en: Eggs are sorted by grade and size before they reach the shelves.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋上架之前，会先按「等级」和大小分好。

words.enDefinition: any broad thin expanse or surface

examples.en: Mom changed every sheet in the house before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到来之前，妈妈把家里的「床单」全都换了。

examples.en: The student placed a clean sheet of paper beside the ink pot.
examples.zh: 学生在墨水瓶旁铺开了一张干净的「纸」。

words.enDefinition: point or extent in space

examples.en: The wedding location changed from the garden to the village hall.
examples.zh: 婚礼「地点」从花园改到了村礼堂。

examples.en: The treasure map shows a location behind the old mill.
examples.zh: 藏宝图标出了旧磨坊后面的一个「位置」。

words.enDefinition: to join or mix two or more things together

examples.en: Combine the flour and eggs slowly to avoid lumps in the batter.
examples.zh: 慢慢把面粉和鸡蛋「混合」，免得面糊结块。

examples.en: The two small shops combined to keep up with the mall.
examples.zh: 两家小店「联合」起来，与新开的商场抗衡。

words.enDefinition: branch of knowledge

examples.en: History is the discipline she chose at university this fall.
examples.zh: 历史是她今年秋天在大学选的「学科」。

examples.en: Psychology as a discipline studies how children learn to share.
examples.zh: 作为一门「学科」，心理学研究儿童如何学会分享。

words.enDefinition: the opposition or dissimilarity of things that are compared

examples.en: In contrast to the noisy market, the library felt calm.
examples.zh: 与嘈杂的市场「相比」，图书馆显得安静。

examples.en: The white flowers show a sharp contrast against the dark soil.
examples.zh: 白花在深色土壤的衬托下形成鲜明的「对比」。

words.enDefinition: man of refinement

examples.en: A kind gentleman helped carry our suitcases to the taxi stand.
examples.zh: 一位好心的「绅士」帮我们把行李提到出租车候客处。

examples.en: Grandfather always tells us that a gentleman keeps his promises.
examples.zh: 祖父常对我们说，「绅士」言而有信。

words.enDefinition: the act of giving out or spreading something among people or places

examples.en: Volunteers handle the distribution of hot meals every Friday evening.
examples.zh: 每周五晚上，志愿者负责「分发」热餐。

examples.en: The distribution of flyers brought forty new faces to the fair.
examples.zh: 「分发」传单为集市带来了四十张新面孔。

words.enDefinition: put in the mind of someone

examples.en: Please remind me to water the ferns before we leave for the coast.
examples.zh: 出发去海边之前，请「提醒」我给蕨类浇水。

examples.en: The old photo reminds Grandpa of his years as a sailor.
examples.zh: 这张旧照片让爷爷「想起」了当水手的岁月。

words.enDefinition: the significance of a story or event

examples.en: The tortoise story carries a moral about patience that kids remember.
examples.zh: 乌龟的故事有个关于耐心的「寓意」，孩子们都记得。

examples.en: At the end, grandma explained the moral of the fox tale.
examples.zh: 故事结尾，奶奶讲解了狐狸故事的「寓意」。

words.enDefinition: associated with academia or an academy

examples.en: Grandma keeps every academic award our family wins on that shelf.
examples.zh: 奶奶把我们家赢得的每个「学业」奖项都摆在那层架子上。

examples.en: Academic writing avoids slang, so cut the joke from your essay.
examples.zh: 「学术」写作忌俚语，把那个玩笑从文章里删掉吧。

words.enDefinition: reply of denial

examples.en: When asked about refunds, the manager's answer was a firm negative.
examples.zh: 被问到退款时，经理给出了干脆的「否定」回答。

examples.en: He replied in the negative when the landlord offered the attic room.
examples.zh: 房东提出阁楼房间时，他给出了「否定的」回答。

words.enDefinition: of or relating to the study of history

examples.en: The town's historical museum reopened after two years of repairs.
examples.zh: 经过两年修缮，镇上的「历史」博物馆重新开放。

examples.en: Grandma loves historical dramas set long before the last war.
examples.zh: 奶奶爱看以多年前的时代为背景的「历史」剧。

words.enDefinition: a substance taken to treat an illness or relieve pain

examples.en: Grandma takes her blood pressure medicine with breakfast every morning.
examples.zh: 奶奶每天早晨随早餐服用降压「药」。

examples.en: The pharmacy closes at nine, so buy cough medicine before then.
examples.zh: 药房九点关门，要在那之前买好「药」。

words.enDefinition: (usually followed by `to') not having the necessary means or skill or know-how

examples.en: The bakery was unable to fill our cake order before noon.
examples.zh: 面包店「无法」在中午前完成我们的蛋糕订单。

examples.en: After the storm, many families were unable to reach the clinic.
examples.zh: 风暴过后，许多家庭「无法」前往诊所。

words.enDefinition: be owned by; be in the possession of

examples.en: This green jacket belongs to my older brother, not to me.
examples.zh: 这件绿夹克「属于」我哥哥，不是我的。

examples.en: Every fishing net here belongs to a family from the harbor.
examples.zh: 这里的每张渔网都「属于」港口的一户人家。

words.enDefinition: regular payment to a person that is intended to allow them to subsist without working

examples.en: Grandpa collects his pension on the first Monday of every month.
examples.zh: 爷爷每月第一个周一领取「养老金」。

examples.en: After thirty years of teaching, she retired on a full pension.
examples.zh: 教书三十年后，她以全额「退休金」退休了。

words.enDefinition: well known from long or close association; easily recognized

examples.en: That familiar tune from the ice-cream truck always brings kids running.
examples.zh: 冰淇淋车那首「熟悉的」曲子总能招来孩子们奔跑。

examples.en: Her face looked familiar, and then I recognized my old classmate.
examples.zh: 那张脸看起来很「面熟」，我随即认出了老同学。

words.enDefinition: a shallow dish used for holding food

examples.en: Grandma piled the last dumpling onto my plate with a smile.
examples.zh: 奶奶笑着把最后一个饺子堆到我的「盘子」里。

examples.en: Please rinse each plate before it goes into the dishwasher.
examples.zh: 每个「盘子」放进洗碗机之前，请先冲一冲。

words.enDefinition: appealing to the emotions as well as the eye

examples.en: The aunties planted a lovely rose garden behind the teahouse.
examples.zh: 阿姨们在茶馆后面种了一个「可爱的」玫瑰园。

examples.en: We had a lovely evening listening to grandpa's old records.
examples.zh: 听着爷爷的老唱片，我们度过了「美好的」一晚。

words.enDefinition: the amount that something can hold or contain

examples.en: This kettle has a capacity of one and a half liters.
examples.zh: 这把水壶的「容量」是一点五升。

examples.en: Whenever the two rivals meet, the stadium fills beyond capacity.
examples.zh: 每逢两队相遇，这座体育场的「容量」都会被挤爆。

words.enDefinition: an instrumentality invented for a particular purpose

examples.en: This small device measures how many steps you walk daily.
examples.zh: 这个小「装置」能测量你每天走了多少步。

examples.en: Grandpa's new hearing device helps him follow our dinner conversations easily.
examples.zh: 爷爷的新助听「设备」让他轻松听清我们晚餐时的谈话。

words.enDefinition: living in or characteristic of farming or country life

examples.en: Rural buses run only twice a day in our county.
examples.zh: 我们县的「乡村」公交一天只跑两趟。

examples.en: They moved to a rural village to keep bees and sheep.
examples.zh: 他们搬到了「乡下」村庄，养蜂又养羊。

words.enDefinition: generic name for certain synthetic or semisynthetic materials that can be molded or extruded into objects or films or filaments or used for making e.g. coatings and adhesives

examples.en: The town market now bans single-use plastic bags at every stall.
examples.zh: 镇上的市场现在禁止每个摊位使用一次性「塑料」袋。

examples.en: Grandma keeps her old buttons in a plastic box by the sewing machine.
examples.zh: 奶奶把旧纽扣收在缝纫机旁的「塑料」盒里。

words.enDefinition: in contrast to the fact that; while on the contrary

examples.en: My sister loves spicy noodles, whereas I prefer sweet dumplings.
examples.zh: 妹妹无辣不欢，「而」我偏爱甜汤圆。

examples.en: The north beach stays windy, whereas the south bay is calm.
examples.zh: 北滩一直有风，「然而」南面的海湾风平浪静。

words.enDefinition: the first letter of a word (especially a person's name)

examples.en: Grandma sewed her initials into every school uniform for us.
examples.zh: 奶奶把她的姓名「首字母」绣进我们每一套校服。

examples.en: Sign your initials on the gym card so the coach knows it's yours.
examples.zh: 在健身卡上签上姓名「首字母」，教练就知道卡是你的了。

words.enDefinition: possessing life

examples.en: The old crabapple tree in the yard is still alive after the frost.
examples.zh: 霜冻过后，院子里那棵老海棠树依然「活着」。

examples.en: Grandma says the whole street feels alive on festival nights.
examples.zh: 奶奶说，节日的夜晚整条街都「充满生气」。

words.enDefinition: concise explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase or symbol

examples.en: The dictionary's definition of patience uses only five simple words.
examples.zh: 词典里对 patience 的「定义」只用了五个简单的词。

examples.en: By strict definition, a tomato is a fruit rather than a vegetable.
examples.zh: 严格按「定义」来说，番茄是水果而不是蔬菜。

words.enDefinition: having a firm basis in reality and being therefore important, meaningful, or considerable

examples.en: The donation made a substantial difference to the village library.
examples.zh: 这笔捐款让乡村图书馆有了「实质」改观。

examples.en: A substantial breakfast of eggs and porridge kept us full till noon.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋加粥的「丰盛」早餐让我们到中午都不饿。

words.enDefinition: the flesh of a chicken used for food

examples.en: Grandma's chicken soup has cured every winter cold in our family.
examples.zh: 奶奶的「鸡汤」治好过我们家每个冬天的感冒。

examples.en: The twins fed corn to the chickens behind the barn.
examples.zh: 双胞胎在谷仓后面喂「鸡」吃玉米。

words.enDefinition: production of a certain amount

examples.en: The garden's tomato output doubled after we built the drip line.
examples.zh: 装上滴灌管之后，花园番茄的「产量」翻了一倍。

examples.en: The printer's output looked blurry until we cleaned the heads.
examples.zh: 清洗打印头之前，打印机的「输出」一直很模糊。

words.enDefinition: meant or adapted for an occasion or use

examples.en: Light rain boots are suitable for the muddy path to the duck pond.
examples.zh: 轻便雨靴很「适合」去鸭塘那条泥泞的小路。

examples.en: The quiet corner of the cafe is suitable for phone interviews.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆的安静角落「适合」接打面试电话。

words.enDefinition: showing reason or sound judgment

examples.en: The landlord asked a reasonable rent after seeing our family budget.
examples.zh: 看过我们的家庭预算后，房东要了个「合理的」租金。

examples.en: It's reasonable to rest halfway on such a long climb.
examples.zh: 这么长的攀登，中途休息是「合理的」。

words.enDefinition: an illegal act or crime that breaks the law

examples.en: Parking on this narrow bridge is now an offence with a fine.
examples.zh: 在这座窄桥上停车现在是「违规行为」，要罚款。

examples.en: The court listed every offence in the report before sentencing.
examples.zh: 宣判之前，法庭列出了报告中的每一项「罪名」。

words.enDefinition: to go up or ascend, especially using the hands and feet or by rising steeply

examples.en: The twins climb the mulberry tree behind grandma's house every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，双胞胎都「爬」奶奶家后面的桑树。

examples.en: Temperatures climbed past thirty degrees, so we moved the picnic into shade.
examples.zh: 气温「升」过三十度，我们把野餐挪到了阴凉处。

words.enDefinition: room used primarily for sleeping

examples.en: The kids' bedroom has glow stars stuck across the ceiling.
examples.zh: 孩子们的「卧室」天花板上贴满了发光星星。

examples.en: We painted the guest bedroom a soft blue before Aunt May visited.
examples.zh: 梅姨来访前，我们把客房的「卧室」刷成了柔和的蓝色。

words.enDefinition: extend in one or more directions

examples.en: The bakery plans to expand into the empty shop next door.
examples.zh: 面包店计划「扩展」到隔壁空出来的店面。

examples.en: Metal expands in summer heat, so the rail joints click louder.
examples.zh: 金属在夏日高温下会「膨胀」，所以铁轨接缝的声响更大。

words.enDefinition: a solid shiny element such as iron, gold, or copper

examples.en: Scrap metal from the old fence paid for the puppy's leash.
examples.zh: 旧栅栏的废「金属」卖了钱，正好给小狗买了牵绳。

examples.en: Touch no bare metal on the stove when the burner is hot.
examples.zh: 炉头烧热时，不要碰灶台上裸露的「金属」。

words.enDefinition: get lost, as without warning or explanation

examples.en: The moon disappeared behind the clouds just before the eclipse.
examples.zh: 月食开始前，月亮「消失」在了云层后面。

examples.en: My left sock always disappears somewhere between the washer and the closet.
examples.zh: 我的左袜子总在洗衣机和衣柜之间「消失」得无影无踪。

words.enDefinition: of a quantity that can fulfill a need or requirement but without being abundant

examples.en: One large pot of soup is sufficient for the whole family dinner.
examples.zh: 一大锅汤就「足够」全家人的晚餐了。

examples.en: The old tent proved sufficient against the light summer rain.
examples.zh: 那顶旧帐篷对付夏日小雨还是「够用的」。

words.enDefinition: relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area

examples.en: Urban bus stops show live waiting times on small screens.
examples.zh: 「城市」公交站的小屏幕实时显示等车时间。

examples.en: They traded their urban flat for a farmhouse with a yard.
examples.zh: 他们用「都市」公寓换了一座带院子的农舍。

words.enDefinition: involving the mind or an intellectual process

examples.en: Chess trains your mental focus better than any phone game does.
examples.zh: 下棋比任何手机游戏都更能锻炼「脑力」专注。

examples.en: Grandpa solves morning crosswords to keep his mental edge sharp.
examples.zh: 爷爷每天早上填字谜，保持「头脑」敏锐。

words.enDefinition: white crystalline carbohydrate used as a sweetener and preservative

examples.en: Add one spoon of sugar to the tea and stir gently.
examples.zh: 往茶里加一勺「糖」，轻轻搅匀。

examples.en: This recipe cuts the sugar in half but keeps the cake moist.
examples.zh: 这个食谱把「糖」减半，蛋糕照样松软湿润。

words.enDefinition: utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)

examples.en: A shout from the lifeguard stopped the kids before the deep water.
examples.zh: 救生员的一声「呼喊」让孩子们止步于深水区前。

examples.en: Grandpa let out a shout of joy when his team scored.
examples.zh: 爷爷支持的球队进球时，他发出了一声「欢呼」。

words.enDefinition: a large celestial body that orbits a star; under the IAU 2006 definition, the Solar System has eight planets (Pluto is classified as a dwarf planet)

examples.en: Saturn is the planet with bright rings that kids love drawing.
examples.zh: 土星是那颗孩子们爱画的、带着明亮光环的「行星」。

examples.en: Astronomers found a new planet beyond our solar system last year.
examples.zh: 去年，天文学家在太阳系外发现了一颗新「行星」。

words.enDefinition: travel to or penetrate into

examples.en: The cousins explored the bamboo grove behind the temple all afternoon.
examples.zh: 表兄妹们「探遍」了寺后的竹林，玩了一下午。

examples.en: Divers explored the sunken ship near the harbor last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，潜水员「探索」了港口附近的沉船。

words.enDefinition: misconception resulting from incorrect information

examples.en: The printer error wasted twenty copies of the school program.
examples.zh: 打印机「出错」浪费了二十份学校节目单。

examples.en: Small spelling errors in the menu made the whole family laugh.
examples.zh: 菜单上的拼写「小错误」逗笑了全家人。

words.enDefinition: an opposing military force

examples.en: In the story, the knight never feared the approaching enemy army.
examples.zh: 故事里，骑士从不畏惧逼近的「敌军」。

examples.en: Mosquitoes are certainly the gardener's worst enemy every humid July.
examples.zh: 潮湿的七月里，蚊子无疑是园丁最大的「敌人」。

words.enDefinition: of or relating to the practice of science

examples.en: The lab uses a scientific method to test the water weekly.
examples.zh: 实验室每周用「科学的」方法检测水质。

examples.en: Grandma trusts scientific answers over folk remedies for the garden.
examples.zh: 在花园的问题上，奶奶更信「科学的」解释，而不是土方。

words.enDefinition: sheet that forms a distinct (usually flat and rectangular) section or component of something

examples.en: The carpenter replaced one broken panel in the garden gate.
examples.zh: 木匠更换了花园门上一块破损的「嵌板」。

examples.en: Solar panels on the roof now heat most of our water.
examples.zh: 屋顶的太阳能「板」现在供应家里大部分热水。

words.enDefinition: make a prediction about; tell in advance

examples.en: The farmer predicts rain by watching the ants carry eggs uphill.
examples.zh: 农民看蚂蚁驮蛋上坡来「预测」下雨。

examples.en: Nobody can predict when the old oak will finally bloom.
examples.zh: 谁也「预测」不了老橡树究竟何时开花。

words.enDefinition: fundamental feeling that is hard to define but that people desire to experience

examples.en: It's a pleasure to watch the sunset from our balcony.
examples.zh: 在阳台上看日落是一种「乐趣」。

examples.en: Grandpa reads his boat logs with quiet pleasure every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，爷爷都带着静静的「愉悦」翻看他的航海日志。

words.enDefinition: carefully chosen from a larger group; of superior quality

examples.en: The restaurant serves select wines from small family-run vineyards nearby.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅供应附近家族小酒庄「精选」的葡萄酒。

examples.en: Only a select group of students joined the astronomy camp.
examples.zh: 只有「精选的」少数学生参加了天文夏令营。

words.enDefinition: small pouch inside a garment for carrying small articles

examples.en: Grandma keeps butterscotch candies in her apron pocket for visitors.
examples.zh: 奶奶的围裙「口袋」里总备着奶油糖招待客人。

examples.en: The ticket was in my coat pocket the entire time.
examples.zh: 车票其实一直就在我外套「口袋」里。

words.enDefinition: At the side of; on one side of.

examples.en: The cat likes to nap beside the warm kitchen window.
examples.zh: 猫咪喜欢在温暖的厨房窗「边」打盹。

examples.en: Set the lanterns beside the gate so guests find the path.
examples.zh: 把灯笼放在大「门旁」，好让客人看清小路。

words.enDefinition: an accusation that brings into intimate and usually incriminating connection

examples.en: The witness's testimony led to the mayor's implication in the case.
examples.zh: 证人的证词导致市长被「牵连」进案件。

examples.en: The lawyer worked hard to avoid any implication of her client.
examples.zh: 律师竭力避免让她的当事人受到「牵连」。

words.enDefinition: in a serious manner

examples.en: The judge listened seriously to every witness before making her ruling.
examples.zh: 法官「认真」听取每位证人的陈述后才作出裁决。

examples.en: Dad took the car noise seriously and booked a mechanic visit.
examples.zh: 爸爸很「重视」车子的异响，预约了检修。

words.enDefinition: in part; in some degree; not wholly

examples.en: The roof leak was partly caused by last month's hail.
examples.zh: 屋顶漏水「部分是」上个月的冰雹造成的。

examples.en: She funds her pottery hobby partly through weekend market sales.
examples.zh: 她的陶艺爱好「部分」靠周末集市摆摊来支撑。

words.enDefinition: in or to another place

examples.en: The mechanic sent us elsewhere because our van needs a special part.
examples.zh: 修理工让我们去「别处」，因为我们的面包车需要特殊配件。

examples.en: The rare seeds sell out here, so look elsewhere if you're late.
examples.zh: 稀有种子在这里已卖光，来晚了就去「别处」找找。

words.enDefinition: in an essential manner

examples.en: Expensive gifts are not necessarily the ones that children remember most.
examples.zh: 贵的礼物「未必」是孩子们记得最久的。

examples.en: A big garden doesn't necessarily produce more tomatoes than a small one.
examples.zh: 大花园「不一定」比小花园产出更多番茄。

words.enDefinition: social unit living together

examples.en: Our whole household wakes at six during the school term.
examples.zh: 上学期间，我们「全家人」六点起床。

examples.en: Every household on the street displayed a lantern for the festival.
examples.zh: 节日里，街上「每户人家」都挂出了灯笼。

words.enDefinition: containing nothing; not filled or occupied

examples.en: An hour after the final whistle, the stadium stood empty.
examples.zh: 终场哨响一小时后，体育场已经「空无一人」。

examples.en: Never leave the kettle sitting empty on a hot burner.
examples.zh: 别把「空」水壶一直放在热炉头上。

words.enDefinition: in some unspecified way or manner; or by some unspecified means

examples.en: Somehow, the cat still opens the gate despite its latch.
examples.zh: 「不知怎么的」，那只猫还是能打开上了闩的门。

examples.en: We somehow fit eight grown cousins into grandma's tiny kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们「居然」把八个成年表亲都塞进了奶奶的小厨房。

words.enDefinition: one skilled in caring for young children or the sick (usually under the supervision of a physician)

examples.en: The night nurse checked on grandpa quietly every two hours.
examples.zh: 夜班「护士」每两小时安静地查看一次爷爷的情况。

examples.en: A nurse at the clinic taught us to bandage a sprained wrist.
examples.zh: 诊所的一位「护士」教我们给扭伤的手腕包扎。

words.enDefinition: the act of conducting a controlled test or investigation

examples.en: Our science experiment tested whether ferns grow toward the window.
examples.zh: 我们的科学「实验」测试蕨类是否朝窗户生长。

examples.en: The children's vinegar experiment filled the whole kitchen with sticky bubbles.
examples.zh: 孩子们的醋「实验」让整个厨房溅满黏黏的泡沫。

words.enDefinition: the front of the trunk from the neck to the abdomen

examples.en: The robin puffed out its red breast before singing at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明歌唱之前，知更鸟挺起了红色的「胸脯」。

examples.en: Grill each chicken breast for six minutes on every side.
examples.zh: 每块鸡「胸肉」两面各煎烤六分钟。

words.enDefinition: the state of being silent (as when no one is speaking)

examples.en: A sudden silence fell over the classroom when the principal walked in.
examples.zh: 校长走进教室时，教室里突然一片「寂静」。

examples.en: Grandpa broke the silence with a story about his first voyage.
examples.zh: 爷爷用一段首航的故事打破了「沉默」。

words.enDefinition: unifying idea that is a recurrent element in literary or artistic work

examples.en: Friendship is the theme of every story in this year's reader.
examples.zh: 友谊是今年读本里每个故事的「主题」。

examples.en: The baker chose a garden theme for grandma's birthday cake.
examples.zh: 面包师为奶奶的生日蛋糕选了花园「主题」。

words.enDefinition: violent weather condition with winds 64-72 knots (11 on the Beaufort scale) and precipitation and thunder and lightning

examples.en: The storm knocked out power across three villages last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚的「暴风雨」让三个村庄断了电。

examples.en: We watched the storm roll in from the safety of the porch.
examples.zh: 我们在门廊的安全处看着「暴风雨」步步逼近。

words.enDefinition: the act of traveling from one place to another

examples.en: The train journey to the mountains takes exactly five hours.
examples.zh: 去山里的火车「旅程」正好五个小时。

examples.en: Grandpa describes his sea journey to this town as the hardest choice.
examples.zh: 爷爷说当年坐船来镇上的「旅程」是最艰难的决定。

words.enDefinition: yellow color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of sunflowers or ripe lemons

examples.en: Yellow suits our sunny kitchen better than gray ever did.
examples.zh: 我们这个向阳的厨房用「黄色」比灰色合适多了。

examples.en: Grandma painted the doorframes bright yellow to match the sunflowers.
examples.zh: 奶奶把门框漆成明亮的「黄色」，与向日葵相呼应。

words.enDefinition: sound of any kind (especially unintelligible or dissonant sound)

examples.en: The neighbor's drilling noise starts exactly at eight each morning.
examples.zh: 邻居的电钻「噪音」每天早上八点准时开始。

examples.en: We ask guests kindly to keep the noise down after ten.
examples.zh: 我们请客人十点以后把「音量」放小一些。

words.enDefinition: shade within clear boundaries

examples.en: The oak's shadow covers the whole picnic table by noon.
examples.zh: 正午时分，橡树的「树荫」遮住了整张野餐桌。

examples.en: Long shadows stretch across the field in the late afternoon.
examples.zh: 傍晚时分，长长的「影子」铺满了田野。

words.enDefinition: bring to a close

examples.en: The mayor concluded the festival with fireworks over the harbor.
examples.zh: 市长以海港上空的烟花为节日「收尾」。

examples.en: After comparing all the recipes, we concluded that grandma's is best.
examples.zh: 对比所有食谱后，我们「得出结论」：奶奶的最棒。

words.enDefinition: express or state indirectly

examples.en: Her smile seemed to imply that the surprise party is still on.
examples.zh: 她的微笑似乎「暗示」惊喜派对还会照常进行。

examples.en: Grandpa's raised eyebrow implied his doubt about my tall fishing story.
examples.zh: 爷爷扬起的眉毛「暗示」他不太信我那些夸张的钓鱼故事。

words.enDefinition: depict with an illustration

examples.en: The teacher illustrated long division with apples on the board.
examples.zh: 老师用黑板上的苹果「讲解」长除法。

examples.en: Bright little sketches illustrate each recipe in grandma's community cookbook.
examples.zh: 奶奶的社区食谱里，每道菜都配有明快的小幅「插图」。

words.enDefinition: an event in which something is displaced without rotation

examples.en: A slight shift in the wind carried the smoke toward our picnic.
examples.zh: 风向的轻微「转变」把烟吹向了我们的野餐地。

examples.en: Grandpa's night shift at the mill ends at four in the morning.
examples.zh: 爷爷在磨坊的「夜班」凌晨四点结束。

words.enDefinition: any distinct time period in a sequence of events

examples.en: Our house is in the painting phase, one room each weekend.
examples.zh: 我们的房子正处在「刷墙阶段」，每周末刷一间。

examples.en: Most toddlers pass through a short phase of refusing vegetables.
examples.zh: 大多数幼儿都会经历拒绝吃蔬菜的「阶段」。

words.enDefinition: readiness to embark on bold new ventures

examples.en: On her own initiative, Mia repainted the fence before anyone asked.
examples.zh: 没人要求，米娅就「主动」把篱笆重新刷了漆。

examples.en: The library's reading initiative gave every child a free book.
examples.zh: 图书馆的阅读「倡议」让每个孩子都拿到了一本免费的书。

words.enDefinition: in essence; at bottom or by one's (or its) very nature

examples.en: Basically, the ferry schedule stays the same all through winter.
examples.zh: 「基本上」，渡轮班次整个冬天都保持不变。

examples.en: Grandpa basically lives in his workshop when the cold sets in.
examples.zh: 天一冷，爷爷「基本上」就住进了他的工作间。

words.enDefinition: bring into existence

examples.en: The rooftop panels generate enough power for the whole guesthouse.
examples.zh: 屋顶的太阳能板「发出」的电足够整个旅馆使用。

examples.en: That old heater still generates strong warmth on freezing nights.
examples.zh: 严寒的夜晚，那台旧取暖器仍能「产生」很强的暖意。

words.enDefinition: general direction in which something tends to move

examples.en: The new trend at the market is selling vegetables in paper bags.
examples.zh: 市场的新「趋势」是用纸袋卖蔬菜。

examples.en: Grandma noticed the trend of young people returning to the village.
examples.zh: 奶奶注意到年轻人返乡的「趋势」。

words.enDefinition: providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (`comfy' is informal)

examples.en: The new sofa is so comfortable that Dad fell asleep at halftime.
examples.zh: 新沙发太「舒服」了，爸爸中场休息就睡着了。

examples.en: Thick socks keep my feet comfortable during the long night shift.
examples.zh: 厚袜子让我在漫长的夜班中双脚保持「舒适」。

words.enDefinition: feeling or showing anger

examples.en: Grandma looked angry when the dog dug up her tulips again.
examples.zh: 狗又把她的郁金香刨了出来，奶奶看起来很「生气」。

examples.en: An angry driver honked when our cart blocked the lane.
examples.zh: 我们的推车挡了道，一位「愤怒的」司机按响了喇叭。

words.enDefinition: the act of catching someone or something and bringing them under control

examples.en: The vet's safe capture of the injured gull took twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 兽医安全「捕获」那只受伤的海鸥花了二十分钟。

examples.en: The fox's capture ended a week of raids on the henhouse.
examples.zh: 那只狐狸被「捕获」后，鸡舍一周来的袭扰才算结束。

words.enDefinition: special importance or significance

examples.en: Mom places great emphasis on finishing homework before dinner every day.
examples.zh: 妈妈特别「强调」每天晚饭前完成作业。

examples.en: The coach put extra emphasis on footwork during Tuesday's drills.
examples.zh: 周二的训练中，教练格外「强调」步法。

words.enDefinition: in accordance with truth or fact or reality

examples.en: The old letter is truly from 1902, says the museum expert.
examples.zh: 博物馆专家说，这封旧信「确实」写于 1902 年。

examples.en: Grandma's dumplings are truly the best at every family gathering.
examples.zh: 家庭聚会上，奶奶的饺子「真的」是最棒的。

words.enDefinition: not thin; of a specific thickness or of relatively great extent from one surface to the opposite usually in the smallest of the three solid dimensions

examples.en: Grandma knitted me a thick scarf before I left for the north.
examples.zh: 我去北方之前，奶奶给我织了一条「厚厚的」围巾。

examples.en: The soup turned thick after an hour of slow simmering.
examples.zh: 小火慢炖一小时后，汤变得「浓稠」。

words.enDefinition: be able to spare or give up

examples.en: We can't afford a new fridge this year, so the old one stays.
examples.zh: 今年我们「买不起新冰箱」，旧的先凑合用。

examples.en: After selling the boat, Dad could finally afford a real vacation.
examples.zh: 卖了船之后，爸爸终于「负担得起」一次像样的假期。

words.enDefinition: the qualities that give pleasure to the senses

examples.en: Everyone stops at the lake to admire the beauty of the pines.
examples.zh: 大家都会在湖边停下，欣赏松林的「美」。

examples.en: Grandma often says that real beauty hides in simple, honest things.
examples.zh: 奶奶常说，真正的「美」藏在简单质朴的事物里。

words.enDefinition: impart knowledge of some fact, state or affairs, or event to

examples.en: Please inform us two days ahead if the delivery time changes.
examples.zh: 如果送货时间有变，请提前两天「通知」我们。

examples.en: The school informed parents about the new bus route by letter.
examples.zh: 学校致信「告知」家长新的校车路线。

words.enDefinition: (followed by `to') applying exclusively to a given category or condition or locality

examples.en: Grandma's dumpling recipe is unique; nobody else folds them like that.
examples.zh: 奶奶的饺子配方「独一无二」，没人像她那样捏褶。

examples.en: Each shell on this beach has its own unique pattern.
examples.zh: 这片海滩的每枚贝壳都有「独特」的花纹。

words.enDefinition: inform (somebody) of something

examples.en: The doctor advised grandpa to walk shorter distances this month.
examples.zh: 医生「建议」爷爷这个月缩短散步的距离。

examples.en: She advised us to book the ferry early during the holiday.
examples.zh: 她「劝」我们假期早点预订渡轮票。

words.enDefinition: the thing regarded as most important; the right to be dealt with first

examples.en: Grandma's health is our family's first priority throughout this winter.
examples.zh: 整个冬天，奶奶的健康都是全家的「头等大事」。

examples.en: The clinic gives priority to elderly patients every single morning.
examples.zh: 诊所每天早晨都让老年患者「优先」就诊。

words.enDefinition: collection of things that have been combined; an assemblage of separate parts or qualities

examples.en: Peanut butter and banana is a strange but tasty combination.
examples.zh: 花生酱配香蕉是个奇怪却美味的「组合」。

examples.en: That soup's secret is the combination of three dried herbs.
examples.zh: 那锅汤的秘诀在于三种干香草的「搭配」。

words.enDefinition: located above or higher than something else; the higher of two parts

examples.en: Grandma keeps her best jams on the upper shelf of the pantry.
examples.zh: 奶奶把最好的果酱放在食品柜「上层的」架子上。

examples.en: The upper deck of the ferry has the best mountain views.
examples.zh: 渡轮「上层」甲板看山景最好。

words.enDefinition: hard bonelike structures in the jaws of vertebrates; used for biting and chewing or for attack and defense

examples.en: The dentist filled my cracked tooth quickly and without any pain.
examples.zh: 牙医迅速而且毫无疼痛地补好了我那颗裂「牙」。

examples.en: Grandma keeps her false teeth in a silver case by the bed.
examples.zh: 奶奶把假「牙」收在床头的银盒子里。

words.enDefinition: the Crown (or the reigning monarch) as the symbol of the power and authority of a monarchy

examples.en: The museum's glass case holds the king's crown from 1600.
examples.zh: 博物馆的玻璃柜里陈列着 1600 年的国王「王冠」。

examples.en: For the school play, mom made a paper crown with gold foil.
examples.zh: 校剧用的「王冠」是妈妈用金箔纸做的。

words.enDefinition: large building formerly occupied by a ruler and fortified against attack

examples.en: The hilltop castle opens to visitors every weekend in summer.
examples.zh: 这座山顶「城堡」夏季每周末向游客开放。

examples.en: From the castle walls, we watched the fishing boats return at dusk.
examples.zh: 站在「城堡」墙上，我们看着渔船在黄昏归港。

words.enDefinition: the reflexive or emphatic form of we/us

examples.en: We fixed the sagging garden gate ourselves last Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 上周六早上，我们「自己」动手修好了下坠的花园门。

examples.en: We should ask ourselves whether the extra fee is really fair.
examples.zh: 我们该「扪心自问」，这笔额外收费是否真的公平。

words.enDefinition: change of position that does not entail a change of location

examples.en: The gentle motion of the train rocked the baby to sleep.
examples.zh: 火车轻轻的「晃动」让宝宝睡着了。

examples.en: Grandpa watched the motion of the windmill from the porch.
examples.zh: 爷爷在门廊里看着风车的「转动」。
