words.enDefinition: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment

examples.en: It soon became apparent that the old bridge needed repairs.
examples.zh: 不久大家就「明显」看出老桥需要维修。

examples.en: The apparent calm of the sea hid a strong current below.
examples.zh: 海面「看似」平静，水下却藏着强劲的暗流。

words.enDefinition: the body of members of an organization or group

examples.en: Your gym membership includes two free training sessions each month.
examples.zh: 你的健身房「会员资格」每月包含两次免费训练。

examples.en: Grandpa's library membership has been active ever since 1978 without interruption.
examples.zh: 爷爷的图书馆「会员」资格自 1978 年起一直有效，从未中断。

words.enDefinition: garment worn on the upper half of the body

examples.en: Dad ironed his best shirt before the family photo on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日全家福之前，爸爸熨好了他最好的「衬衫」。

examples.en: Grandpa wears a checkered shirt every time he tends the bees.
examples.zh: 爷爷每次去照看蜂箱都穿着格子「衬衫」。

words.enDefinition: someone who is licensed to operate an aircraft in flight

examples.en: The pilot announced a bumpy descent because of evening winds.
examples.zh: 「飞行员」广播说傍晚有风，下降时会颠簸。

examples.en: My uncle trained as a pilot and now flies small cargo planes.
examples.zh: 我叔叔接受过「飞行员」训练，现在驾驶小型货机。

words.enDefinition: as the end result of a succession or process

examples.en: The long negotiations ultimately saved our village library from closing.
examples.zh: 漫长的谈判「最终」保住了乡村图书馆，使其免于关闭。

examples.en: We got lost twice, but ultimately found the waterfall before dark.
examples.zh: 我们迷路两次，但「最终」赶在天黑前找到了瀑布。

words.enDefinition: cause somebody to adopt a certain position, belief, or course of action; twist somebody's arm

examples.en: Mom persuaded Dad to repaint the fence before the rainy season.
examples.zh: 妈妈「说服」爸爸在雨季来临前重刷篱笆。

examples.en: Nobody could persuade grandpa to replace his old leather boots.
examples.zh: 谁也「劝不动」爷爷换掉他的旧皮靴。

words.enDefinition: pleasing to the eye or mind especially through beauty or charm

examples.en: The bakery window looks especially attractive with fresh strawberry tarts.
examples.zh: 摆上新鲜的草莓塔后，面包店的橱窗格外「吸引人」。

examples.en: Grandma finds the idea of winter camping attractive but too cold.
examples.zh: 奶奶觉得冬季露营的主意「有吸引力」，只是太冷了。

words.enDefinition: a corridor or narrow way through which people can move

examples.en: A narrow stone passage connects the kitchen to the old cellar.
examples.zh: 一条狭窄的石砌「通道」连接着厨房与老地窖。

examples.en: Keep the passage clear of boxes in case of an emergency.
examples.zh: 应急「通道」里不要堆纸箱，务必保持畅通。

words.enDefinition: to take something that belongs to someone else without permission

examples.en: Someone stole the garden gnome from grandma's front yard last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚有人偷走了奶奶前院的花园「小矮人」雕像。

examples.en: The raccoon tried to steal bread from the unguarded picnic basket.
examples.zh: 浣熊想「偷」没人看管的野餐篮里的面包。

words.enDefinition: follow in or as if in pursuit

examples.en: The dog pursued the frisbee all the way down the hill.
examples.zh: 小狗一路「追着」飞盘跑下了山坡。

examples.en: Mia hopes to pursue her dream of opening a small bakery.
examples.zh: 米娅希望「追求」她开一家小面包店的梦想。

words.enDefinition: experiencing odd bodily sensations

examples.en: Grandpa's funny impression of the rooster wakes everyone before dawn.
examples.zh: 爷爷学公鸡的「滑稽」样子总在天亮前把全家逗醒。

examples.en: The comedy club booked a funny local comedian for Saturday.
examples.zh: 喜剧俱乐部为周六请来了一位「好笑的」本地喜剧演员。

words.enDefinition: someone deranged and possibly dangerous

examples.en: The kids went crazy with excitement when the snow finally fell.
examples.zh: 雪终于落了下来，孩子们「疯狂」地欢呼雀跃。

examples.en: Grandpa is crazy about fishing, whether it rains or shines.
examples.zh: 爷爷「痴迷」于钓鱼，风雨无阻。

words.enDefinition: get or find back; recover the use of

examples.en: The coast guard helped the fishermen recover their drifting nets.
examples.zh: 海岸警卫队帮渔民「找回」了漂走的渔网。

examples.en: It took grandpa a month to recover from the winter flu.
examples.zh: 爷爷花了一个月才从冬季流感中「恢复」过来。

words.enDefinition: series of things depending on each other as if linked together

examples.en: The bicycle chain snapped halfway up the steep hill this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上上陡坡爬到一半，自行车的「链条」断了。

examples.en: A chain of small islands marks the ferry route south.
examples.zh: 渡轮南线的沿途有一「串」小岛作标志。

words.enDefinition: an expert who is devoted to one occupation or branch of learning

examples.en: The clinic sent grandma to an eye specialist downtown this morning.
examples.zh: 今天上午，诊所让奶奶去市里找眼科「专科医生」就诊。

examples.en: A heating specialist fixed our frozen basement pipes within an hour.
examples.zh: 一位供暖「专家」一小时内就修好了地下室冻住的管道。

words.enDefinition: distinguishing quality

examples.en: Patience is the most noticeable characteristic of our village postman.
examples.zh: 耐心是我们村邮递员最显眼的「特点」。

examples.en: A sweet corn filling is the characteristic feature of grandma's dumplings.
examples.zh: 甜玉米馅是奶奶饺子「特有」的标志。

words.enDefinition: belonging to the very distant past; very old

examples.en: We explored the ancient temple ruins above the tea fields.
examples.zh: 我们探访了茶园上方「古老的」神庙遗迹。

examples.en: Grandma keeps an ancient family recipe older than the town itself.
examples.zh: 奶奶保留着一份比镇子历史还「古老」的家传食谱。

words.enDefinition: find the solution to (a problem or question) or understand the meaning of

examples.en: Grandpa solved the leaking faucet with a rubber ring and patience.
examples.zh: 爷爷用一枚橡胶垫圈和耐心「解决」了水龙头漏水的问题。

examples.en: The kids solved the riddle on the treasure map before lunch.
examples.zh: 孩子们午饭前就「解开了」藏宝图上的谜题。

words.enDefinition: an expanse of scenery that can be seen in a single view

examples.en: The valley's autumn landscape turns to gold above the vineyards.
examples.zh: 秋天的山谷「风景」在葡萄园上方染成一片金色。

examples.en: Grandpa paints the rural landscape every Saturday morning near the mill.
examples.zh: 每周六早上，爷爷都在磨坊附近画乡村「风景」。

words.enDefinition: a border that holds a picture, door, or window in place

examples.en: Grandma's gold frame holds a photo of her wedding day.
examples.zh: 奶奶的金色「相框」里装着她结婚那天的照片。

examples.en: Dad repaired the broken frame of the kitchen window before winter.
examples.zh: 入冬之前，爸爸修好了厨房窗户损坏的「框」。

words.enDefinition: people who are old collectively

examples.en: An elderly couple walks the seawall every morning at dawn.
examples.zh: 一对「上了年纪的」夫妇每天清晨沿着海堤散步。

examples.en: The bus has priority seats for elderly passengers near the door.
examples.zh: 公交车靠近车门处设有「老年」乘客的优先座。

words.enDefinition: large body of water constituting a principal part of the hydrosphere

examples.en: The ferry crossed the calm ocean for six hours straight.
examples.zh: 渡轮在平静的「海洋」上连续航行了六个小时。

examples.en: Grandpa's stories describe sailors mapping the ocean by the stars.
examples.zh: 爷爷讲的故事里，水手们靠星星在「大海」上辨认航路。

words.enDefinition: person who lives (or is located) near another

examples.en: Our friendly neighbour shares tomatoes from his garden every August.
examples.zh: 每年八月，我们友善的「邻居」都会分享他园子里的番茄。

examples.en: The new neighbour from upstairs fixed our squeaky gate yesterday.
examples.zh: 楼上新搬来的「邻居」昨天修好了我们吱呀作响的大门。

words.enDefinition: (usually followed by `of') having capacity or ability

examples.en: Our capable neighbour repairs almost any bicycle problem at her shed.
examples.zh: 我们那位「能干的」邻居在她的棚屋里几乎能修好所有自行车故障。

examples.en: Grandma is quite capable of carrying two market bags upstairs.
examples.zh: 奶奶完全「有能力」拎着两袋菜上楼。

words.enDefinition: cause to be attached

examples.en: Please attach the receipt to the warranty card before mailing it.
examples.zh: 寄出之前，请把收据「附在」保修卡上。

examples.en: Grandma attached a small charm to my new school bag.
examples.zh: 奶奶在我的新书包上「系了」一个小挂饰。

words.enDefinition: polished surface that forms images by reflecting light

examples.en: The hall mirror shows our whole family before school each morning.
examples.zh: 每天早晨上学前，门厅的「镜子」照出我们全家。

examples.en: Grandpa adjusted the car mirror so grandma could see the sea.
examples.zh: 爷爷调整了车内「后视镜」，好让奶奶看见大海。

words.enDefinition: intelligent and quick to learn; showing good judgment

examples.en: The smart shepherd dog counts the sheep better than I do.
examples.zh: 那只「聪明的」牧羊犬数羊比我还准。

examples.en: It was smart to book the ferry before the holiday rush.
examples.zh: 赶在假日高峰之前订渡轮票很「明智」。

words.enDefinition: line spoken by an actor to the audience but not intended for others on the stage

examples.en: The actor's whispered aside made the entire theater burst out laughing.
examples.zh: 演员低声的「旁白」逗得全场观众大笑。

examples.en: Grandpa muttered an aside to grandma during the mayor's speech.
examples.zh: 市长演讲时，爷爷向奶奶低声「嘀咕」了一句。

words.enDefinition: person working in the service of another (especially in the household)

examples.en: In the old manor, each servant had a fixed daily duty.
examples.zh: 在旧庄园里，每个「仆人」都有固定的日常职责。

examples.en: The story's loyal servant hides the letter inside the flour jar.
examples.zh: 故事里忠心的「仆人」把信藏进了面粉罐。

words.enDefinition: at or in or to any place; (`anyplace' is used informally for `anywhere')

examples.en: You can park anywhere along this quiet street after six.
examples.zh: 六点以后，这条安静的街上「随便哪儿」都能停车。

examples.en: Grandma won't find better dumplings anywhere else in this town.
examples.zh: 在这个镇上，奶奶「到哪儿」都找不到更好吃的饺子。

words.enDefinition: person who uses scientific knowledge to solve practical problems

examples.en: The young engineer fixed the village bridge's cracked support beam.
examples.zh: 年轻的「工程师」修好了村桥开裂的支撑梁。

examples.en: My aunt is an engineer who designs quiet train stations.
examples.zh: 我姑姑是一名设计安静火车站的「工程师」。

words.enDefinition: in or to a place that is lower

examples.en: The cat naps beneath the old oak on hot afternoons.
examples.zh: 炎热的午后，猫在老橡树「下」打盹。

examples.en: We found grandpa's compass beneath a pile of old maps.
examples.zh: 我们在一摞旧地图「底下」找到了爷爷的指南针。

words.enDefinition: to a limited degree; a little rather than completely

examples.en: The revised train timetable is somewhat clearer than the old one.
examples.zh: 修改后的火车时刻表比旧的「稍微」清楚一些。

examples.en: Grandma seemed somewhat surprised by the size of our sunflowers.
examples.zh: 看到我们向日葵的个头，奶奶显得「有点」吃惊。

words.enDefinition: properties attributable to your ancestry

examples.en: Grandma traced the origin of our dumpling recipe to Shandong.
examples.zh: 奶奶把我们饺子配方的「起源」追溯到了山东。

examples.en: The museum explains the origin of the town's hot springs.
examples.zh: 博物馆讲解了这个镇温泉的「由来」。

words.enDefinition: an area of sand sloping down to the water of a sea or lake

examples.en: The quiet beach near the lighthouse is perfect for shell collecting.
examples.zh: 灯塔附近安静的「海滩」最适合捡贝壳。

examples.en: We built a driftwood shelter on the beach before high tide.
examples.zh: 涨潮之前，我们在「海滩」上搭了一个浮木棚。

words.enDefinition: go or travel along with

examples.en: Grandma will accompany the twins to their first dentist visit.
examples.zh: 奶奶会「陪同」双胞胎去做第一次牙科检查。

examples.en: Uncle Ray accompanied us on accordion during the harvest dinner.
examples.zh: 丰收晚餐上，雷叔叔用手风琴为我们「伴奏」。

words.enDefinition: a person who is under the legal age of adulthood

examples.en: Minors must show a parent's note to join the night tour.
examples.zh: 「未成年人」须出示家长的字条才能参加夜游。

examples.en: The gym refuses membership to any minor without a guardian.
examples.zh: 健身房不接受没有监护人的「未成年人」入会。

words.enDefinition: any collection of particles (e.g., smoke or dust) or gases that is visible

examples.en: A single white cloud drifted above the wheat field at noon.
examples.zh: 正午时分，一朵白「云」飘在麦田上空。

examples.en: Storm clouds gathered over the harbor just before the race.
examples.zh: 比赛开始前，暴风雨「云」在海港上空聚集。

words.enDefinition: large and unbroken expanse or distance

examples.en: The final stretch of the coastal road hugs the cliff.
examples.zh: 沿海公路最后的「一段」紧贴着悬崖。

examples.en: Grandpa does a careful leg stretch before every morning walk.
examples.zh: 爷爷每天晨走之前都认真「伸展」双腿。

words.enDefinition: edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant

examples.en: Grandma's market stall sells the freshest vegetable bundles on Fridays.
examples.zh: 奶奶的市集摊位每周五出售最新鲜的「蔬菜」扎。

examples.en: Every dinner at grandpa's includes at least one green vegetable.
examples.zh: 在爷爷家吃饭，每顿晚餐至少有一道绿色「蔬菜」。

words.enDefinition: large and stately mansion

examples.en: The summer palace opens its gardens to visitors in May.
examples.zh: 这座夏「宫」的花园五月向游客开放。

examples.en: Our school trip includes the throne room of the old palace.
examples.zh: 学校旅行包括参观老「宫殿」的王座厅。

words.enDefinition: to or in any or all places; (`everyplace' is used informally for `everywhere')

examples.en: After the festival, confetti and ribbons lay everywhere on the square.
examples.zh: 节日过后，广场「到处」都散落着彩纸屑和丝带。

examples.en: Grandma plants marigolds everywhere the sun touches our front yard.
examples.zh: 前院里阳光照到的「每个角落」，奶奶都种上了万寿菊。

words.enDefinition: be against; express opposition to

examples.en: Villagers oppose the plan to pave the old orchard path.
examples.zh: 村民们「反对」把老果园小路铺成硬化路面的计划。

examples.en: Grandpa opposes selling the family's boat, even at a good price.
examples.zh: 爷爷「反对」卖掉家里的船，哪怕出价不错。

words.enDefinition: large formal assembly

examples.en: The comics convention fills the whole exhibition hall every September.
examples.zh: 每年九月，动漫「大会」都挤满整个展览馆。

examples.en: Delegates booked every hotel room weeks before the convention began.
examples.zh: 「大会」开幕前几周，代表们就订满了所有酒店房间。

words.enDefinition: person of nearly the same age as another

examples.en: The museum compares grandma's paintings with those of her contemporaries.
examples.zh: 博物馆把奶奶的画与她「同时代的人」的作品并列展出。

examples.en: My father and his contemporaries built this harbor by hand.
examples.zh: 父亲和他的「同龄人」们当年徒手建起了这座港口。

words.enDefinition: control consisting of a mechanical or electrical or electronic device for making or breaking or changing the connections in a circuit

examples.en: The attic light's switch sits right beside the stair door.
examples.zh: 阁楼灯的「开关」就在楼梯门旁边。

examples.en: Grandpa flipped the main switch before fixing the porch lamp.
examples.zh: 爷爷修门廊灯之前，先扳下了总「开关」。

words.enDefinition: the sound of knocking (as on a door or in an engine or bearing)

examples.en: A gentle knock at the front door announced the postman.
examples.zh: 前门轻轻的「敲门声」宣告邮差来了。

examples.en: Grandpa heard a knock in the engine and stopped the tractor.
examples.zh: 爷爷听到发动机里有「敲击声」，停下了拖拉机。

words.enDefinition: in distinction from others

examples.en: Grandma knitted this scarf specifically for my winter trip north.
examples.zh: 奶奶这条围巾是「特意」为我去北方过冬织的。

examples.en: The coach asked Mia specifically to warm up her shoulders.
examples.zh: 教练「明确」要求米娅做好肩部热身。

words.enDefinition: depleted of strength or energy

examples.en: The tired harvest workers rested under the walnut tree at noon.
examples.zh: 中午，「疲惫的」收割工人们在核桃树下休息。

examples.en: Grandpa sounded really tired after carrying the harvest crates upstairs.
examples.zh: 把收获的箱子搬上楼后，爷爷的声音听起来真「累」。

words.enDefinition: show to be reasonable or provide adequate ground for

examples.en: The boys struggled to justify the broken window to grandpa.
examples.zh: 男孩们努力向爷爷「辩白」窗户是怎么打碎的。

examples.en: The council justified the new parking fee with flood-repair costs.
examples.zh: 议会用防洪维修的开支来「证明」新停车费的合理。

words.enDefinition: someone who sees an event and reports what happened

examples.en: The only witness to the bakery fire was the night baker.
examples.zh: 面包店火灾唯一的「目击者」是值夜班的面包师。

examples.en: Each witness told the court a slightly different version of events.
examples.zh: 每位「证人」向法庭讲述的经过都略有不同。

words.enDefinition: remote and separate physically or socially

examples.en: The twins sit apart in class so they stop whispering.
examples.zh: 双胞胎在班里被安排「分开坐」，免得总讲悄悄话。

examples.en: Grandma's two rocking chairs stand three feet apart by the window.
examples.zh: 奶奶的两把摇椅在窗边「相隔」三英尺摆放。

words.enDefinition: to stress, single out as important

examples.en: The dentist emphasized daily flossing twice during our short checkup.
examples.zh: 短暂检查期间，牙医两次「强调」每天要用牙线。

examples.en: Grandpa emphasized patience while teaching me to mend the net.
examples.zh: 爷爷教我补渔网时，「反复强调」要有耐心。

words.enDefinition: feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth; or being a reason for pride

examples.en: Mom looked proud when the choir sang my solo perfectly.
examples.zh: 合唱团完美地唱出我的独唱时，妈妈满脸「骄傲」。

examples.en: Grandpa is proud of the orchard he planted forty years ago.
examples.zh: 爷爷为自己四十年前种下的果园感到「自豪」。

words.enDefinition: without question and beyond doubt

examples.en: The bakery definitely opens earlier than usual on market days.
examples.zh: 赶集的日子，面包店「肯定」比平时开门早。

examples.en: I will definitely bring grandma's umbrella; the forecast looks wet.
examples.zh: 天气预报有雨，我「一定」带上奶奶的伞。

words.enDefinition: continuing or enduring without marked change in status or condition or place

examples.en: The library set up a permanent shelf for local authors.
examples.zh: 图书馆为本地作家设立了一个「永久」书架。

examples.en: The scar on his thumb looks permanent after the harvest accident.
examples.zh: 秋收事故之后，他拇指上的疤痕像是「永久」留下了。

words.enDefinition: extraordinarily large in size, amount, or degree

examples.en: An enormous wave soaked everyone standing near the harbor wall.
examples.zh: 一个「巨大的」浪头浇湿了海堤边所有的人。

examples.en: Grandpa felt enormous pride when the town renamed the ferry pier.
examples.zh: 小镇以他的名字命名渡轮码头时，爷爷心中涌起「巨大的」自豪。

words.enDefinition: in an original manner

examples.en: This guesthouse was originally the station master's house in 1910.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆「最初」是 1910 年建成的站长住宅。

examples.en: We originally planned a picnic, but the storm changed our minds.
examples.zh: 我们「本来」计划去野餐，但风暴让我们改变了主意。

words.enDefinition: simple machine consisting of a circular frame with spokes (or a solid disc) that can rotate on a shaft or axle (as in vehicles or other machines)

examples.en: Grandpa oiled every wheel of the old handcart before market day.
examples.zh: 赶集日之前，爷爷给旧手推车的每个「轮子」都上了油。

examples.en: The wagon lost a wheel halfway down the muddy lane.
examples.zh: 马车在泥泞小巷走到一半，掉了一个「轮子」。

words.enDefinition: make an investment

examples.en: Dad decided to invest his bonus in a small bakery.
examples.zh: 爸爸决定把年终奖「投资」到一家小面包店。

examples.en: They plan to invest in solar panels for the farmhouse.
examples.zh: 他们计划「投资」为农舍安装太阳能板。

words.enDefinition: a thick wire or bundle of wires that carries electricity or signals

examples.en: The storm brought down the TV cable along our street.
examples.zh: 暴风雨把我们街上电视的「线缆」刮断了。

examples.en: Dad tied the loose cable to the post until the repair crew arrived.
examples.zh: 维修队到来之前，爸爸先把松脱的「电缆」绑到柱子上。

words.enDefinition: a regular article or feature written by the same writer in a newspaper or magazine

examples.en: Grandma clips every column about village history from the weekly paper.
examples.zh: 奶奶把周报上每篇关于村庄历史的「专栏」都剪了下来。

examples.en: The young chef answers cooking questions in her Saturday column.
examples.zh: 那位年轻厨师在周六的「专栏」里回答烹饪问题。

words.enDefinition: foundation created to promote the public good (not for assistance to any particular individuals)

examples.en: The village charity raises money for the school's new library.
examples.zh: 村里的「慈善机构」为学校的新图书馆筹款。

examples.en: Grandma donates knitted socks to a children's charity every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，奶奶都把织好的袜子捐给儿童「慈善机构」。

words.enDefinition: matter that is solid at room temperature and pressure

examples.en: Water becomes a solid when the pond freezes in January.
examples.zh: 一月份池塘结冰时，水就变成了「固体」。

examples.en: Our science poster shows liquid, solid, and gas side by side.
examples.zh: 我们的科学海报上并排展示着液体、「固体」和气体。

words.enDefinition: located inward

examples.en: The inn's inner courtyard stays pleasantly cool even in July.
examples.zh: 即使在七月，旅馆的「内」院依然凉爽宜人。

examples.en: Grandpa opened the clock's inner mechanism to clean the gears.
examples.zh: 爷爷打开时钟的「内部」机件来清理齿轮。

words.enDefinition: the first meal of the day (usually in the morning)

examples.en: Grandma's breakfast always includes warm rice porridge and salted duck eggs.
examples.zh: 奶奶的「早餐」总是有热粥和咸鸭蛋。

examples.en: We grabbed a quick breakfast at the station before the ferry.
examples.zh: 上渡轮之前，我们在车站匆匆吃了「早饭」。

words.enDefinition: have a celebration

examples.en: The whole street will celebrate the harvest with lanterns tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚整条街都会挂起灯笼「庆祝」丰收。

examples.en: We celebrated grandma's seventieth birthday with a small garden feast.
examples.zh: 我们用一场小小的庭院盛宴「庆祝」了奶奶的七十大寿。

words.enDefinition: an official document giving permission to do something

examples.en: You need a fishing permit for the river below the dam.
examples.zh: 在大坝下游的河段钓鱼需要「许可证」。

examples.en: The market permit must be renewed before the first of March.
examples.zh: 集市的「许可证」必须在三月一日前换新。

words.enDefinition: a basic principle, rule, or essential element

examples.en: Before racing, every cyclist learns the fundamentals of road safety.
examples.zh: 参赛之前，每个骑行者都要学习道路安全的「基本原理」。

examples.en: Grandpa taught me the fundamentals of knot tying on the boat.
examples.zh: 爷爷在船上教了我系绳结的「基本功」。

words.enDefinition: in essence or effect but not in fact

examples.en: The twins are virtually impossible to tell apart at the station.
examples.zh: 在车站，这对双胞胎「几乎」无法分辨。

examples.en: The old mill is virtually silent now that the river dried up.
examples.zh: 自从河水干涸，老磨坊「几乎」没了声息。

words.enDefinition: in a perfect or faultless way

examples.en: The new reading glasses fit grandma perfectly after one adjustment.
examples.zh: 微调一次之后，新配的老花镜「完全」适合奶奶。

examples.en: The train arrived perfectly on time despite the morning fog.
examples.zh: 尽管清晨有雾，火车还是「分秒不差」地准点到达。

words.enDefinition: not usual or common or ordinary

examples.en: It's unusual to see frost on the windows in late March.
examples.zh: 三月底窗上还结着霜，真是「不寻常」。

examples.en: Grandma served an unusual soup made from young bamboo shoots.
examples.zh: 奶奶端上一道用嫩竹笋做的「不寻常的」汤。

words.enDefinition: make (someone) agree, understand, or realize the truth or validity of something

examples.en: Mia convinced her parents to let her keep the stray kitten.
examples.zh: 米娅「说服」父母让她收留那只流浪小猫。

examples.en: Grandpa tried to convince me the old compass still points true.
examples.zh: 爷爷努力「说服」我相信那只旧指南针依然指得准。

words.enDefinition: a case that does not follow the general rule

examples.en: Every shop closes on Sunday, with the exception of the bakery.
examples.zh: 周日每家店都关门，「唯有」面包店「例外」。

examples.en: Grandma makes an exception to her diet on her birthday.
examples.zh: 奶奶在自己生日那天会对节食「破例」。

words.enDefinition: an official document that gives legal permission to do something

examples.en: Grandpa renewed his fishing licence at the post office today.
examples.zh: 爷爷今天在邮局续办了「钓鱼执照」。

examples.en: You must show a valid driving licence before renting the van.
examples.zh: 租面包车之前必须出示有效的驾驶「执照」。

words.enDefinition: to leave a place, person, or thing completely; to give up an idea or activity

examples.en: The crew had to abandon the sinking boat near the breakwater.
examples.zh: 船员们不得不在防波堤附近「弃船」。

examples.en: Grandma abandoned her plan to walk to the market in the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴之中，奶奶「放弃」了步行去市场的计划。

words.enDefinition: make by combining materials and parts

examples.en: The twins helped dad construct a small coop for the chicks.
examples.zh: 双胞胎帮爸爸「搭建」了一个养小鸡的小笼子。

examples.en: Villagers constructed a bamboo bridge across the stream last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，村民们「建造」了一座跨溪的竹桥。

words.enDefinition: responsible for or chargeable with a reprehensible act

examples.en: The court found the smuggler guilty of hiding untaxed goods.
examples.zh: 法庭判定走私者「有罪」，他藏匿了未完税的货物。

examples.en: I felt guilty about eating the cake meant for grandma's guest.
examples.zh: 吃了本来要招待奶奶客人的蛋糕，我心里很「内疚」。

words.enDefinition: compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others

examples.en: Local bakers compete for the best pie at the harvest fair.
examples.zh: 丰收集市上，本地的面包师们「争夺」最佳馅饼奖。

examples.en: Our village team will compete against three schools this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，我们村队将与三所学校「比赛」。

words.enDefinition: search for knowledge

examples.en: The housing office answered our inquiry about the new flats quickly.
examples.zh: 房管部门很快答复了我们关于新公寓的「询问」。

examples.en: An official inquiry opened after the ferry docked two hours late.
examples.zh: 渡轮晚点两小时之后，有关方面展开了「调查」。

words.enDefinition: (geology) a crack in the earth's crust resulting from the displacement of one side with respect to the other

examples.en: The broken fence was nobody's fault; the storm did it.
examples.zh: 篱笆坏了「谁也没有过错」，是暴风雨弄的。

examples.en: Grandpa laughed and admitted it was his fault we missed the ferry.
examples.zh: 爷爷笑着承认，错过渡轮「都怪他」。

words.enDefinition: to a severe or serious degree

examples.en: The garden was badly flooded after two days of rain.
examples.zh: 连下两天雨之后，花园被「严重」淹了。

examples.en: The twins badly wanted to join the fishing trip on Saturday.
examples.zh: 双胞胎「非常」想参加周六的钓鱼之旅。

words.enDefinition: an expression consisting of one or more words forming a grammatical constituent of a sentence

examples.en: Under the weather is a common phrase for feeling slightly ill.
examples.zh: 「Under the weather」是个常用「短语」，表示有点不舒服。

examples.en: Please repeat that phrase slowly; the accent is hard for me.
examples.zh: 请慢一点重复那个「短语」，那个口音我听着费劲。

words.enDefinition: an amount or number of something; how much there is

examples.en: This recipe needs a small quantity of salt, not a spoonful.
examples.zh: 这个食谱只需要「少量」的盐，不用一整勺。

examples.en: Grandma records the quantity of eggs each hen lays every week.
examples.zh: 奶奶记录着每只母鸡每周下蛋的「数量」。

words.enDefinition: an unknown and unexplored region

examples.en: The hikers took an unknown trail behind the old lighthouse.
examples.zh: 徒步者们走了老灯塔后面一条「未知的」小径。

examples.en: The cause of the engine knock remains unknown to the mechanic.
examples.zh: 发动机异响的原因，修理工仍然「不明」。

words.enDefinition: as might be expected

examples.en: Naturally, the twins finished their jigsaw puzzle before any of us.
examples.zh: 「不用说」，双胞胎比我们所有人都先拼完了拼图。

examples.en: Grandpa speaks naturally in front of crowds after forty years of harvest fairs.
examples.zh: 四十年的赶集经验让爷爷在人前讲话非常「自然」。

words.enDefinition: move ahead; travel onward in time or space

examples.en: After the rain stopped, the cyclists proceeded along the canal path.
examples.zh: 雨停之后，骑行者们沿着运河小路「继续前进」。

examples.en: Please proceed to gate three; the ferry boarding starts now.
examples.zh: 请「前往」三号门，渡轮现在开始登船。

words.enDefinition: (psychology) a state of mental or emotional strain or suspense

examples.en: There was clear tension in the room before the exam results.
examples.zh: 成绩公布之前，教室里的气氛明显很「紧张」。

examples.en: Grandpa adjusted the tension of the fishing line before casting.
examples.zh: 抛竿之前，爷爷调好了钓线的「张力」。

words.enDefinition: relating to the human spirit or soul rather than material things

examples.en: Grandma finds spiritual comfort in her morning walks by the river.
examples.zh: 奶奶在清晨的河畔散步中找到「精神」上的慰藉。

examples.en: The temple offers a quiet, spiritual escape from the noisy market.
examples.zh: 这座寺庙能让人躲开喧闹的市场，获得「心灵」的安宁。

words.enDefinition: play or film whose action and dialogue is interspersed with singing and dancing

examples.en: The school musical this year is based on a folk legend.
examples.zh: 今年的校园「音乐剧」取材于一个民间传说。

examples.en: Grandma hums songs from the old musical she saw in 1968.
examples.zh: 奶奶哼着 1968 年看过的那部「音乐片」里的歌。

words.enDefinition: finely ground tobacco wrapped in paper; for smoking

examples.en: Grandpa finally quit cigarettes after the doctor's warning last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天医生的警告之后，爷爷终于戒了「香烟」。

examples.en: Please smoke your cigarette outside; the baby is sleeping upstairs.
examples.zh: 请到外面抽「烟」，宝宝正在楼上睡觉。

words.enDefinition: in addition; furthermore, their quality is improving"; moreover, mice nested there"

examples.en: The bakery moved to Main Street; moreover, it now opens on Sundays.
examples.zh: 面包店搬到了大街上；「而且」现在周日也营业。

examples.en: The tent leaked; moreover, the zipper broke on the first night.
examples.zh: 帐篷漏水；「此外」，拉链在第一天晚上就坏了。

words.enDefinition: food made from dough of flour or meal and usually raised with yeast or baking powder and then baked

examples.en: Grandma bakes rye bread every Thursday for the weekend guests.
examples.zh: 每周四，奶奶都为周末的客人烤黑麦「面包」。

examples.en: The corner bakery sells day-old bread at half price after eight.
examples.zh: 街角的面包店八点以后半价出售隔天「面包」。

words.enDefinition: sharp piercing cry

examples.en: A sudden scream from the garden brought every adult running outside.
examples.zh: 花园里突然的「尖叫」让所有大人都跑了出去。

examples.en: The roller coaster drew screams of joy from the twins.
examples.zh: 过山车引来了双胞胎们「欣喜的尖叫」。

words.enDefinition: everything that exists anywhere

examples.en: The planetarium show explains how the universe began fourteen billion years ago.
examples.zh: 天文馆的影片讲解「宇宙」在 140 亿年前是如何开始的。

examples.en: Grandpa says every snowflake is a tiny universe of its own.
examples.zh: 爷爷说，每片雪花都是一个「小宇宙」。

words.enDefinition: make an alteration to

examples.en: The tailor will alter grandma's coat to fit my shoulders.
examples.zh: 裁缝会把奶奶的外套「改」得合我的肩宽。

examples.en: Rain in the forecast may alter our ferry plans this weekend.
examples.zh: 天气预报有雨，也许会「改变」我们周末的渡轮计划。

words.enDefinition: having or bringing good fortune; favored by luck

examples.en: We were lucky to catch the last ferry before the storm.
examples.zh: 我们很「幸运」，赶上了暴风雨前的末班渡轮。

examples.en: Grandma considers herself lucky to have such helpful young neighbours.
examples.zh: 奶奶觉得自己「运气好」，有这么乐于助人的年轻邻居。

words.enDefinition: structure taller than its diameter; can stand alone or be attached to a larger building

examples.en: The town's old bell tower overlooks the whole market square.
examples.zh: 镇上古老的钟「塔」俯瞰着整个集市广场。

examples.en: The castle's stone tower stands watch over the river bend.
examples.zh: 城堡的石「塔」守望着河湾。

words.enDefinition: intrude or enter uninvited

examples.en: Sorry to bother you, but is this seat already taken?
examples.zh: 抱歉「打扰」一下，这个座位已经有人了吗？

examples.en: Don't bother grandma while she is still talking on the phone.
examples.zh: 奶奶还在打电话的时候，别去「打扰」她。

words.enDefinition: belonging to or associated with the person or people being addressed

examples.en: Is this red umbrella yours? I found it beside the ferry gate.
examples.zh: 这把红伞是「你的」吗？我在渡轮门边捡到的。

examples.en: Mine is the blue tent, and the green one is yours.
examples.zh: 蓝色帐篷是我的，绿色的那顶是「你的」。

words.enDefinition: an alloy of iron with small amounts of carbon; widely used in construction; mechanical properties can be varied over a wide range

examples.en: The shipyard workers shape heavy steel plates into boat hulls.
examples.zh: 船厂工人把厚重的「钢板」加工成船体。

examples.en: Grandpa's knife keeps its edge because it is made of steel.
examples.zh: 爷爷的刀一直锋利，因为它是「钢」做的。

words.enDefinition: acting with or marked by or resulting from great force or energy or emotional intensity

examples.en: The violent storm snapped the old flagpole outside the school.
examples.zh: 「猛烈」的风暴刮断了学校外的旧旗杆。

examples.en: The film is too violent for the younger kids at home.
examples.zh: 这部电影「暴力」镜头太多，不适合家里的小孩子看。

words.enDefinition: the extent downward or backward or inward

examples.en: The pool's shallow end has a depth of one meter.
examples.zh: 泳池浅水端的「深度」为一米。

examples.en: Grandpa measures the depth of the well with a knotted rope.
examples.zh: 爷爷用一根打了结的绳子测量井的「深度」。

words.enDefinition: the act of passing the ball to a teammate in a way that leads to a score

examples.en: The point guard led the league with eleven assists per game.
examples.zh: 这位控球后卫以场均十一次「助攻」领跑联盟。

examples.en: Her perfect assist helped the striker score the winning goal.
examples.zh: 她的一记完美「助攻」帮助前锋打进了制胜球。

words.enDefinition: an authoritative direction or instruction to do something

examples.en: The captain's command sent every sailor to the deck at once.
examples.zh: 船长的一声「命令」让所有水手立刻上了甲板。

examples.en: Grandpa taught our dog the command to sit before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭前，爷爷教会了我们的狗「坐下」的「口令」。

words.enDefinition: single thickness of usually some homogeneous substance

examples.en: Grandma's lasagna has a cheese layer between every pasta sheet.
examples.zh: 奶奶的千层面每两张面皮之间都夹着一「层」奶酪。

examples.en: Workers spread a fresh layer of gravel on the muddy path.
examples.zh: 工人在泥泞的小路上铺了新的一「层」碎石。

words.enDefinition: lightweight cord

examples.en: Grandma ties dried chili peppers together with a long red string.
examples.zh: 奶奶用一根长长的红「线」把干辣椒串在一起。

examples.en: The kite string snapped when the wind gusted over the hill.
examples.zh: 山口的阵风一吹，风筝「线」啪地断了。

words.enDefinition: small flat rectangular piece of glass on which specimens can be mounted for microscopic study

examples.en: The biology teacher prepared a slide with onion skin cells.
examples.zh: 生物老师制备了一张洋葱表皮细胞的「载玻片」。

examples.en: Project the next slide, please; it shows the tide chart.
examples.zh: 请放映下一张「幻灯片」，上面是潮汐表。

words.enDefinition: to find a solution to a problem; to make a firm decision

examples.en: The neighbours resolved their fence dispute over a pot of tea.
examples.zh: 邻居们喝着一壶茶，「解决」了篱笆纠纷。

examples.en: Mia resolved to practice the accordion every evening after dinner.
examples.zh: 米娅「下定决心」每天晚饭后练习手风琴。

words.enDefinition: the social event at which the ceremony of marriage is performed

examples.en: The village wedding ended with dancing under glowing paper lanterns.
examples.zh: 乡村「婚礼」在点亮的纸灯笼下载歌载舞，就此收尾。

examples.en: Grandma wore her best silk scarf to cousin Amy's wedding.
examples.zh: 奶奶戴着她最好的丝围巾去参加表妹艾米的「婚礼」。

words.enDefinition: a person who competes against another in a contest or argument

examples.en: Our chess club finally beat our oldest opponent, Harbor School.
examples.zh: 我们棋社终于战胜了最老的「对手」——港口学校。

examples.en: Grandpa greeted each opponent warmly before the fishing contest began.
examples.zh: 钓鱼比赛开始前，爷爷与每位「对手」热情地打招呼。

words.enDefinition: subject to a mathematical transformation

examples.en: Grandma transformed the spare room into a sunny reading nook.
examples.zh: 奶奶把空余的房间「改造成了」阳光充足的读书角。

examples.en: The old harbor transformed into a lively market over ten years.
examples.zh: 十年之间，旧港口「变」成了热闹的市集。

words.enDefinition: marked by dissimilarity

examples.en: The two brothers are unlike in temperament yet best friends.
examples.zh: 兄弟俩性情「迥异」，却是最好的朋友。

examples.en: Unlike shades of green cover each square of the patchwork quilt.
examples.zh: 拼布被子的每个方块都用了「不同的」绿色。

words.enDefinition: being effective without wasting time or effort or expense

examples.en: The new kettle is efficient and boils water in half the time.
examples.zh: 新水壶很「高效」，烧水只要一半的时间。

examples.en: Grandma's tiny kitchen stays efficient with everything within arm's reach.
examples.zh: 奶奶的小厨房「高效」实用，所有东西都伸手可及。

words.enDefinition: arid land with little or no vegetation

examples.en: The camel caravan crossed the desert only during the cool nights.
examples.zh: 骆驼商队只在凉爽的夜间穿越「沙漠」。

examples.en: Cacti store water to survive long droughts in the desert.
examples.zh: 仙人掌会储存水分，好在「沙漠」的长期干旱中存活。

words.enDefinition: an interval during which a recurring sequence of events occurs

examples.en: The washing machine's extra rinse cycle takes fifteen more minutes.
examples.zh: 洗衣机额外的漂洗「周期」要多花十五分钟。

examples.en: Grandma plants by the moon's cycle, as her mother taught her.
examples.zh: 奶奶按月亮的「周期」播种，这是她母亲教她的。

words.enDefinition: to calculate or estimate an amount or number

examples.en: Grandpa reckons the fence repair will cost about fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 爷爷「估算」修篱笆大约要花五十美元。

examples.en: I reckon the whole journey takes about five hours by bus.
examples.zh: 我「估计」全程坐大巴要五个小时左右。

words.enDefinition: to keep something safe from harm or change; to maintain in good condition

examples.en: The whole village works to preserve its century-old stone bridge.
examples.zh: 全村人都在努力「保护」那座有百年历史的石桥。

examples.en: Grandma preserves the summer peaches in jars of light syrup.
examples.zh: 奶奶用淡糖水把夏天的桃子「腌制」装罐「保存」。
